④经济利益依然重要，但它与其他目标形成了竞争。
⑤正如几十年后非洲后殖民国家的新领导人所做的那样，新的苏联政权愿意为电影提供补贴，因为它认识到电影作为一种宣传工具是多么有效；1920 年代的大多数苏联电影制片人，尽管他们往往有令人信服的美学议程，但却乐于支持革命政治。
⑥此外，苏联是一个多民族、多语言的异质、不统一的国家。
⑦大多数人不识字。
⑧电影，尤其是无声电影，可以将这些事实转化为对国家有利的因素，仅凭影像就能起到启迪和说服的作用。

⑨与许多苏联电影人一样，非洲电影 "之父"、小说家OS也认识到了电影的政治力量。
⑩OS曾在苏联学习电影制作，之所以转向电影，正是因为他明白，价格和文盲率限制了书籍向大众传播的力量。

qs.stem: The author of the passage suggests which of the following about filmmakers in the Soviet Union in the 1920s?
qs.zh: 关于 20 世纪 20 年代苏联的电影制作人，作者暗示了以下哪项？

opts.t: Many had powerful ideas about how to exploit film as an artistic medium.
opts.cn: 许多人对如何将电影作为一种艺术媒介加以利用有着强烈的想法。

opts.t: They tended to be suspicious of the state' s motives for subsidizing films.
opts.h: They tended to be suspicious of the state' s motives for subsidizing films.
opts.cn: 他们往往怀疑国家补贴电影的动机。

opts.t: Their work had little influence on that of Ousmane Sembene.
opts.cn: 他们的作品对 OS 的作品影响不大。

opts.t: In general, they had learned their filmmaking in the years preceding the 1917 revolution.
opts.cn: 总的来说，他们是在 1917 年革命前的岁月里学习电影制作的。

opts.t: They came from many of the different ethnic groups that made up the Soviet population.
opts.cn: 他们来自构成苏联人口的许多不同民族。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
文章中提到 "most Soviet filmmakers in the 1920s, though they often had compelling aesthetic agendas, readily supported the politics of revolution"（虽然他们经常有引人注目的美学议程，但他们仍然支持革命的政治），这表明这些苏联电影人对如何利用电影作为一种艺术媒介有着强烈的想法，对应A选项。

其他选项：
They tended to be suspicious of the state' s motives for subsidizing films.
文章没有提到苏联电影人对国家资助电影的动机持怀疑态度，相反，他们支持革命的政治。
Their work had little influence on that of Ousmane Sembene.
文章提到 S 受到了苏联电影的影响。
In general, they had learned their filmmaking in the years preceding the 1917 revolution.
文章没有提到这些电影人是在1917年革命前学习的电影制作。
They came from many of the different ethnic groups that made up the Soviet population.
文章提到苏联是一个由多种民族和语言组成的异质联合体，但并没有明确表示这些电影人来自不同的民族群体。

qs.stem: According to the passage, Ousmane Sembene resembled many Soviet filmmakers in the 1920s in that he
qs.zh: 根据文章，OS与 20 世纪 20 年代的许多苏联电影制作人相似，因为他

opts.t: felt that a new approach to filmmaking was needed to make cinema relevant
opts.cn: 认为需要一种新的电影制作方法来使电影具有现实意义

opts.t: turned to film after working in another artistic medium
opts.cn: 在从事其他艺术媒介的工作后转向电影

opts.t: targeted an ethnically diverse audience with his films
opts.cn: 他的电影面向不同种族的观众

opts.t: worked with an awareness of cinema's political potential
opts.h: worked with an awareness of cinema's political potential
opts.cn: 意识到电影的政治潜力

opts.t: traveled abroad in order to learn filmmaking
opts.cn: 出国学习电影制作

qs.label: D
qs.why:
根据“Ousmane Sembene”定位到第二段第一句：Like many Soviet filmmakers, Ousmane Sembene, a novelist and the "father" of African cinema, recognized film's political potency. 与许多苏联电影人一样，非洲电影 "之父"、小说家OS也认识到了电影的政治力量。
即OS和1920年代的许多苏联电影制作人一样，都认识到了电影作为传播政治信息和观念的有效工具，对应D选项。

其他选项：
felt that a new approach to filmmaking was needed to make cinema relevant
虽然文章提到苏联革命改变了电影制作的方式，但没有明确说明 S 也认为需要一种新的电影制作方法来使电影变得相关。
turned to film after working in another artistic medium
虽然文章提到 S 是一位小说家，并且后来转向了电影，但文章中没有明确提到苏联电影制片人也是从其他艺术媒介转向电影的。
targeted an ethnically diverse audience with his films
虽然文章提到苏联有一个由不同种族和语言组成的异质混合体，但没有具体说明 S 也将目标对准了一个民族多样化的观众群体。
traveled abroad in order to learn filmmaking
虽然文章提到 S 在苏联学习电影制作，但没有提到苏联电影制片人也曾出国学习电影制作。

html:
As it was published in 1935, Mules and Men, Zora Neale Hurston's landmark collection of folktales, may not have been the book that its author first had in mind. In this anthropological study, Hurston describes in detail the people who tell the stories, often even inserting herself into the storytelling scene. Evidently, however, Hurston had prepared another version, a manuscript that was recently discovered and published after having been forgotten since 1929. This version differs from Mules and Men in that it simply records stories, with no descriptive or interpretive information.

While we cannot know for certain why Hurston’s original manuscript went unpublished during her lifetime, it may have been because publishers wanted something more than a transcription of tales. Contemporary novelist and critic John Edgar Wideman has described Black literature as the history of a writing that sought to escape its frame, in other words, as the effort of Black writers to present the stories of Black people without having to have a mediating voice to explain the stories to a non-Black audience. In this, Hurston may have been ahead of her time.
zh:
①ZNH具有里程碑意义的民间故事集《骡子和人》出版于 1935 年，这可能不是作者最初设想的那本书。
②在这本人类学研究著作中，H详细描述了讲述故事的人们，甚至经常将自己融入讲故事的场景中。
③不过，H显然还准备了另一个版本，这份手稿自 1929 年被遗忘后，最近才被发现并出版。
④这个版本与《骡子和人》的不同之处在于，它只是记录故事，没有任何描述性或解释性信息。

⑤虽然我们无法确定H的原稿为何在她生前没有出版，但这可能是因为出版商想要的不仅仅是故事的记录。
⑥当代小说家和评论家JEW将黑人文学描述为一部试图摆脱框架的写作史，换句话说，黑人作家努力展现黑人的故事，而不需要一个中介的声音来向非黑人读者解释这些故事。
⑦在这一点上，H可能走在了时代的前列。

qs.stem: The author of the passage suggests that Wideman's comment is related to Hurston' s work in which of the following ways?
qs.zh: 作者认为W的评论与H的作品有以下哪方面的联系？

opts.t: His comment introduces uncertainty into the dating of the two versions of her folktale collection.
opts.cn: 他的评论给她的民间故事集的两个版本的年代带来了不确定性。

opts.t: His comment was the inspiration for the method she used to compile her folktale collection.
opts.cn: 他的评论是H编纂民间故事集的方法的灵感来源。

opts.t: His comment is derived from his evaluation of the changes she made in transforming the first version into the second.
opts.cn: 他的评论来自于他对她在将第一个版本转化为第二个版本时所作改动的评价。

opts.t: His comment is distant enough in time from her work so as not to apply in precise terms to her work.
opts.cn: 他的评论在时间上与她的作品相距甚远，因此不能准确地适用于她的作品。

opts.t: His comment provides a general basis for explaining what might have been her original intent for the folktale collection.
opts.cn: 他的评论为解释她编写民间故事集的初衷提供了一个总体依据。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
W描述了黑人作家试图呈现黑人故事的努力，而不需要通过一个中介声音向非黑人观众解释这些故事。这与H在她的原始手稿中采取的方法相呼应，她只是记录故事，没有加入描述性或解释性的信息。即，JEW关于黑人文学的评论提供了一个角度，帮助我们理解ZNH为何在她的原始手稿中选择了一种更直接、无介入式的叙述方式，对应E选项。

其他选项：
His comment introduces uncertainty into the dating of the two versions of her folktale collection.
W的评论并没有提到关于H作品版本日期的不确定性。原文中没有提到W对两个版本日期的评论或质疑。
His comment was the inspiration for the method she used to compile her folktale collection.
原文并没有说明W的评论是H编纂民间故事集的灵感来源。事实上，W的评论是在H的作品之后的时代发表的。
His comment is derived from his evaluation of the changes she made in transforming the first version into the second.
W的评论并不是基于对H版本变化的评估。W的评论更广泛地讨论了黑人文学的历史和特点，而不是特定针对H的作品改变。
His comment is distant enough in time from her work so as not to apply in precise terms to her work.
尽管W的评论与H的工作时间上相隔较远，但评论提供的观点依然可以用来解释H的创作意图和方法，如E选项所述。

html: In 1776, the state of New Jersey adopted a constitution that ignored gender in its suffrage clause, defining voters simply as adult residents worth at least fifty pounds. After 1776 women routinely participated in the state's electoral process, until, in 1807, the state legislature passed a law redefining voters solely as adult White male taxpaying citizens. Political historians have been perplexed by New Jersey's deviation from the established norm of exclusive male suffrage, finding no sign of public agitation either for or against the voting rights of women prior to their enfranchisement in 1776 or disenfranchisement in 1807. Consequently historians, downplaying the extent to which women actually voted, have treated female suffrage as the result of careless constitutional construction and viewed the 1807 disenfranchisement as a legislative effort to remedy this carelessness. Yet examination of revolutionary-era manuscripts indicates that the 1776 suffrage clause underwent close legislative scrutiny that led to several significant changes: thus, the absence of gender references in the final version was probably not accidental. Indeed, the evidence suggests that New Jersey's legislators believed that all who possessed sufficient net worth were entitled to vote. However, they also saw the net worth qualification as serving to prevent an overdemocratization of the voting process.
zh:
①1776 年，新泽西州通过了一部宪法，其中的选举权条款忽略了性别因素，仅将选民定义为身价至少 50 英镑的成年居民。
②1776 年后，妇女经常参与该州的选举进程，直到 1807 年，该州立法机构通过一项法律，将选民重新定义为纳税的成年白人男性公民。
③政治历史学家对新泽西州偏离男性专享选举权的既定规范感到困惑，因为在1776年妇女获得选举权或1807年被剥夺选举权之前，没有迹象表明公众对妇女选举权的支持或反对。
④因此，历史学家淡化了妇女实际投票的程度，将女性选举权视为粗心大意的宪法构建的结果，并将 1807 年剥夺选举权视为纠正这种粗心大意的立法努力。
⑤然而，对革命时期手稿的研究表明，1776 年的选举权条款经过了严密的立法审查，导致了几处重大修改：因此，最终版本中没有提及性别问题可能并非偶然。
⑥事实上，证据表明，新泽西州的立法者认为，所有拥有足够净资产的人都有权投票。
⑦不过，他们也认为净资产资格是为了防止投票过程过度民主化。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that the author of the passage would probably disagree with the “historians” over the extent to which
qs.zh: 可以推断，作者可能与 "历史学家 "在以下问题上存在分歧

opts.t: there was public agitation in New Jersey regarding voting rights for women prior to the adoption of the 1776 state constitution
opts.cn: 在 1776 年新泽西州宪法通过之前，新泽西州公众就妇女投票权问题进行了骚动

opts.t: the suffrage clause adopted in New Jersey in 1776 was the product of deliberate intent
opts.cn: 1776 年新泽西州通过的选举权条款是深思熟虑的产物

opts.t: the disenfranchisement law passed in New Jersey in 1807 was carelessly constructed
opts.cn: 1807 年新泽西州通过的剥夺选举权法是粗心大意的产物

opts.t: New Jersey deviated from the established norm of exclusive male suffrage after 1776
opts.cn: 新泽西州在1776年后偏离了男性专享选举权的既定规范

opts.t: New Jersey legislators were concerned in 1776 about the overdemocratization of the voting process
opts.cn: 新泽西州立法者在1776年对投票过程过度民主化表示担忧

qs.label: B
qs.why:
historians 的说法：“treated female suffrage as the result of careless constitutional construction.”
作者的说法：“1776 suffrage clause underwent close legislative scrutiny … was probably not accidental.”
这就是核心分歧，作者认为是 deliberate（有意），historians 认为是 careless（无意）。选B选项。

其他选项：
there was public agitation in New Jersey regarding voting rights for women prior to the adoption of the 1776 state constitution
原文：“finding no sign of public agitation either for or against … prior to their enfranchisement in 1776 or disenfranchisement in 1807.”
作者并没有反驳这一点，他接受了没有证据表明有公众骚动。所以作者 同意 historians 在这一点上的看法，不是分歧点。

the disenfranchisement law passed in New Jersey in 1807 was carelessly constructed
historians 说 1807 是 “remedy this carelessness”。即 1807 是故意修正之前的“错误”。
作者并没有说 1807 法律是 “careless”，而只是说 1776 的条款不是 careless。没有证据表明作者否认 1807 的法律是 deliberate，所以这不是分歧点。

New Jersey deviated from the established norm of exclusive male suffrage after 1776
原文：“New Jersey's deviation from the established norm of exclusive male suffrage”作者也承认这是事实。不是争论点。

New Jersey legislators were concerned in 1776 about the overdemocratization of the voting process
原文：“they also saw the net worth qualification as serving to prevent an overdemocratization of the voting process.”作者直接陈述了这个事实，historians 没有否认。

qs.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to
qs.zh: 文章的主要目的是

opts.t: challenge the prevailing historical explanation for the lack of public agitation regarding women's voting rights in New Jersey in the late-eighteenth and early-nineteenth century
opts.h: challenge the prevailing historical explanation for the lack of public agitation regarding women's voting rights in New Jersey in the late-eighteenth and early-nineteenth century
opts.cn: 质疑对十八世纪末十九世纪初新泽西州妇女投票权缺乏公开鼓动的普遍历史解释

opts.t: question a widely accepted argument regarding the consequences of the disenfranchisement of women in New Jersey in 1807
opts.cn: 对 1807 年新泽西州剥夺妇女选举权的后果这一广为接受的论点提出质疑

opts.t: evaluate various explanations for why New Jersey adopted certain constitutional provisions in 1776 that were contrary to those of other states
opts.cn: 对新泽西州为何在1776年通过某些与其他州相反的宪法条款的各种解释进行评估

opts.t: dispute the prevailing explanation of a particular feature of the state constitution adopted by New Jersey in 1776
opts.cn: 对新泽西州1776年通过的州宪法的某一特点的主流解释提出异议

opts.t: consider certain inconsistencies in a conventional argument about the extent to which women in New Jersey voted after 1776
opts.cn: 考虑有关 1776 年后新泽西州妇女投票程度的传统论点中的某些不一致之处

qs.label: D
qs.why:
文章首先描述了新泽西州一异常行为，然后陈述了历史学家对此的困惑。随后，文章指出了历史学家的一种普遍解释，然后对这一解释提出了反驳。
因此，文章的主要目的是质疑对1776年新泽西州宪法某特定特征（即性别在选举权上的不明确性）的普遍解释，表明这一特征很可能是有意为之，而非历史学家普遍认为的疏忽所致。


其他选项：
challenge the prevailing historical explanation for the lack of public agitation regarding women's voting rights in New Jersey in the late-eighteenth and early-nineteenth century
文章关注的是“1776 年宪法无性别限制”这一条款的来龙去脉，而不是“公众为何没抗议”。作者只有一句话提到公众反应：“Political historians have been perplexed … finding no sign of public agitation…”

question a widely accepted argument regarding the consequences of the disenfranchisement of women in New Jersey in 1807
作者讨论的是原因（为何会先赋权、后取消），而不是 1807 取消后产生了什么后果。全文没有分析 1807 取消投票权对社会造成的影响；重点在“为什么当初条款会这样写”。

evaluate various explanations for why New Jersey adopted certain constitutional provisions in 1776 that were contrary to those of other states
“evaluate various explanations”暗示作者比较多种理论；实际上文章只介绍一种传统解释并提出自己的反驳，不是多方评估。
“Consequently historians…have treated female suffrage as the result of careless constitutional construction…” → 只列一种传统说法，然后作者用证据推翻。

consider certain inconsistencies in a conventional argument about the extent to which women in New Jersey voted after 1776
虽然作者提到历史学家低估投票次数，但目的并不是梳理这些“不一致”，而是驳斥“条款是疏忽”这一解释。 “Consequently historians, downplaying the extent to which women actually voted, have treated female suffrage as the result of careless constitutional construction…” → 投票多少只是传统解释的一个副产品，不是作者的主旨。

qs.stem: The author of the passage takes the “significant changes” to be an indication of which of the following?
qs.zh: 作者认为 "重大变化 "表明了以下哪项？

opts.t: That the 1776 suffrage clause was not established without critical examination.
opts.cn: 1776 年的选举权条款不是未经严格审查就确立的。

opts.t: That there was little consensus among legislation regarding the final version of the 1776 suffrage clause.
opts.cn: 立法机构对 1776 年选举权条款的最终版本几乎没有达成共识。

opts.t: That the 1776 suffrage clause was not a deviation from the norm that prevailed in other states.
opts.cn: 1776 年的选举权条款并没有偏离其他州通行的标准。

opts.t: That there was at least some public agitation in favor of voting rights for women prior to 1776.
opts.cn: 在 1776 年之前，至少有一些支持妇女投票权的公众骚动。

opts.t: That legislation in 1776 were seriously concerned about the overdemocritization of the voting process.
opts.cn: 1776 年的立法对投票程序过度民主化表示严重关切。

qs.label: A

html:
This passage discusses Mionan buildings constructed during the Bronze Age on the Greek Island of Crete.

Although the term “Palace” is widely used and deeply ingrained in Minoan archaeology, Driesen has marked that term has been used to describe a number of quite different things and that there is no consensus on what the term signifies. The debate usually centers on the presumed functions of the building. Evans assumes that the building known as Places has several roles, including royal residences, administrative centers, economic centers, manufacturing centers, and cult centers. Over the years, each of those functions has been called into questions. For example, Schoep notes, “The use of the term Palace carries with it a whole host of perhaps unhelpful baggage, which consciously or unconsciously encourages interpretation of the “Palace” as the residence of a royal elite, occupying supreme position within a hierarchical social and political structure” ; she suggests using the more neutral term “court-centered building” instead. The problem, however, come not from the architectural label one applies, but from making unwarranted assumptions about how the Palaces were used. I use the word “Palaces” (capitalized to signal its arbitrariness) not to imply a range of functions but to refer to a group of buildings that share a set of formal elements.
zh:
这篇文章讨论了在青铜时代建造于希腊克里特岛上的米诺斯建筑。

①虽然“宫殿”一词在米诺斯考古学中被广泛使用并已深入人心，但 Driesen 指出，这个词被用来描述许多相当不同的事物，而且对该词的含义并没有共识。
②争论通常集中在这些建筑的推测功能上。
③Evans 认为，被称作“宫殿”的建筑具有多种角色，包括王室居所、行政中心、经济中心、制造中心以及宗教祭祀中心。
④然而，随着时间的推移，这些功能都陆续受到质疑。
⑤举例来说，Schoep 指出：“‘宫殿’这一术语带有大量或许并无益处的附加含义，它会有意或无意地引导人们把‘宫殿’理解为王室精英的居所，并认为其在一个等级森严的社会和政治结构中占据至高地位”；她建议改用更中性的术语“以庭院为中心的建筑”。
⑥不过，问题并不在于我们给建筑贴上的标签，而在于人们对“宫殿”如何被使用所做的毫无根据的假设。
⑦作者表示，他使用“Palaces”一词（首字母大写以表明其任意性），并不是为了暗示这些建筑有某种特定功能，而是单纯用来指代一组在形式要素上具有共性的建筑。

qs.zh: 引用I. S的话是为了

opts.t: suggest that the debate surrounding the Palaces’ function has been misguided
opts.cn: 暗示围绕宫殿功能的辩论被误导了

opts.t: caution against a particular understanding of the Palaces’ function
opts.cn: 警告不要持有某种对宫殿功能的特定理解

opts.cn: 解释为什么宫殿可能没有被皇室精英用作住宅

opts.t: support a claim by the author that the term “Palace” should no longer be used
opts.cn: 支持了作者的观点，认为“宫殿”一词不应再使用

qs.why:
加粗部分是一个具体的例子，IS在质疑”将宫殿解释为皇室精英的住所“。S 的核心观点是提醒大家不要轻易地假设这些建筑是为王室精英设计的。因此，她在警告（caution against）某种特定的理解，即这些建筑的功能是作为王室住所。
作者引用 IS 的话，是为了展示一种对 “Palace” 这个词的担忧：这个词会让研究者把这些建筑预设成“王室精英住所”，对应B选项。

其他选项：
suggest that the debate surrounding the Palaces’ function has been misguided
这句话只是提醒 “Palace” 这个词会带来“royal elite residence”这类预设。
它并没有说整个关于功能的争论都是 misguided（被误导的）。后文作者也只是说问题在于 “unwarranted assumptions about how the Palaces were used”，不是否定整个 debate。

articulate a hypothesis about the Palaces’ function that the author goes on to critique
这句话是在说 “Palace” 这个词会鼓励人们产生某种解释：“as the residence of a royal elite”。这是一种被警惕的预设，不是 Schoep 自己提出的功能假说。

explain why the Palaces were probably not used as residences by a royal elite
这句话只是说这个词会让人倾向于这样理解，并提醒这种理解可能带有 “unhelpful baggage”。不是在证明这些建筑实际用途是什么。

support a claim by the author that the term “Palace” should no longer be used
Schoep 确实建议用更中性的 “court-centered building”，但作者后面明确说：“I use the word ‘Palaces’ …”。
作者并没有主张这个词“不应该再用”，而是说自己会继续使用，但只是把它当作建筑标签，不暗示具体功能。

opts.h: continue to see the Palaces as being the residences of a royal elite

qs.label: C
qs.why:
定位到作者的态度（第六句）：The problem, however, come not from the architectural label one applies, but from making unwarranted assumptions about how the Palaces were used.
这句话直接指向了辩论的误导性质，即依赖于对建筑使用方式的可疑观念，对应C选项。

其他选项：
have been too quick to abandon the functional categories established by Evans
文章中并没有提到参与争论的人们很快放弃了E 建立的功能分类。
have assigned functions to the buildings on an arbitrary basis
虽然文章提到不同的功能假设，但并没有直接说这些功能是随意分配的。
are generally reluctant to see social hierarchy as relevant to the function of the buildings
虽然提到了社会等级的假设，但文章并没有说参与者普遍不愿意将社会等级与建筑功能联系起来。
continue to see the Palaces as being the residences of a royal elite
虽然文章讨论了这种观点，但并未表明这是作者认为争论误导的原因。

qs.stem: The author would most likely agree with which of the following statements about the use of the term “Palace” in Minoan archaeology?
qs.zh: 作者最可能同意关于在M文明考古学中使用“宫殿”一词的哪项陈述？

opts.t: It is useful largely as a matter of convention
opts.cn: 作为惯例，它在很大程度上是有用的

opts.t: It should be replaced by a more neutral term
opts.cn: 它应该被一个更中立的术语取代

opts.t: It is the correct term for most of the Minoan buildings to which it has been applied.
opts.cn: 这个术语适用于大多数被应用到的米诺斯建筑

opts.t: It has only recently become popular among archaeologists.
opts.cn: 它最近才在考古学家中流行起来

opts.t: It has been used to describe buildings that are formally dissimilar to one another.
opts.cn: 它被用来描述形式上互不相似的建筑

qs.label: A
qs.why:
“Although the term ‘Palace’ is widely used and deeply ingrained in Minoan archaeology…”
“I use the word ‘Palaces’ (capitalized to signal its arbitrariness) not to imply a range of functions but to refer to a group of buildings that share a set of formal elements.”
作者承认“Palace”一词带着历史包袱，却选择保留它，原因只是“大家都这么叫”（惯例）而不是它在形式或功能上真有精准指涉。也就是说，“Palace”对作者来说主要是一个习惯性的便利称呼，对应A选项。

其他选项：
It should be replaced by a more neutral term
Schoep 的确建议改称 “court-centered building”，但作者马上说“问题不在标签”，并坚持继续用 “Palaces”。他认为只要别把功能想当然地套进去，用什么词无伤大雅，说明作者并不主张必须改名。

It is the correct term for most of the Minoan buildings to which it has been applied
作者强调学界对“Palace”含义 毫无共识，而且此词“随意(arbitrary)”。既然连含义都悬而未决，就谈不上它“正确”地指称了多数建筑。

It has only recently become popular among archaeologists
“widely used and deeply ingrained(根深蒂固)” 恰恰说明这个词由来已久、早已普及，不是“最近才流行”。

It has been used to describe buildings that are formally dissimilar to one another.
作者承认别人把这词套到“quite different things”上，但他随后重新界定：本文中“Palaces”专指在 形式(formal elements) 相似 的一群建筑。他关心的是别人对“功能”乱猜，而不是这些建筑在外观上迥异。说它被用于“形式极不相似”（formally dissimilar）的建筑，不代表作者立场。

html: Historically, more cold-adapted antelope species originating in Eurasia have migrated into Africa, where the climate is generally warmer, than have warm-adapted African species into Eurasia. A likely explanation for this involves the fact that intercontinental migrations require both a land bridge connecting the two continents and the suitable habitat both on and across that land bridge. During periods of climatic cooling, such as the various ice ages, the land bridge is open for a long time (because sea level remains low) and is usable by cold-adapt species because cool habitats then extend across it. Thus during cooling most migrants would be expected to travel toward Africa, which is near the equator, since this is the direction dictated by habitat changes on a cooling Earth. In contrast, when the Earth is warm, the land bridge is reduced or gone because sea level is relatively high then. Only during the short lag between onset of global temperature change and sea level response can warm-adapted species migrate from the equator toward higher latitudes.
zh:
①从历史上看，原产于欧亚大陆的适应寒冷的羚羊物种迁徙到非洲的数量要多于适应温暖的非洲物种迁徙到欧亚大陆的数量。
②造成这种情况的一个可能原因是，洲际迁徙需要有连接两个大陆的陆桥，以及陆桥上和陆桥对面的合适栖息地。
③在气候变冷时期，如各种冰河时期，陆桥会长期开放（因为海平面一直很低），适应寒冷的物种可以使用陆桥，因为凉爽的栖息地会延伸到陆桥的另一侧。
④因此，在地球变冷时，大多数迁徙者都会向赤道附近的非洲迁徙，因为这是地球变冷时栖息地变化所决定的方向。
⑤相反，当地球变暖时，陆桥会缩小或消失，因为那时海平面相对较高。
⑥只有在全球气温开始变化与海平面反应之间的短暂滞后期，适应暖气候的物种才能从赤道向高纬度迁移。

qs.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is true of an Eurasia-Africa land bridge during ice ages?
qs.zh: 根据这段文字，以下哪项符合冰河时期欧亚非陆桥的情况？

opts.t: It offers suitable habitats for cold-adapted species of antelope.
opts.cn: 它为适应寒冷的羚羊物种提供了合适的栖息地。

opts.t: It encourages migration from Africa to Eurasia of cold-adapted species of antelope.
opts.cn: 它鼓励适应寒冷的羚羊物种从非洲迁徙到欧亚大陆。

opts.t: It allows the survival of warm-adapted species of antelope that might otherwise home extinct.
opts.cn: 它使适应暖气候的羚羊物种得以生存，否则这些物种可能会灭绝。

opts.t: It is more likely to exist early in an ice age than later in an ice age.
opts.cn: 它在冰河时期早期比在冰河时期晚期更有可能存在。

opts.t: The habitats it offers change more quickly than do those offered by land bridges during other periods.
opts.cn: 它提供的栖息地比其他时期陆桥提供的栖息地变化更快。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
根据关键词ice age定位到第三句：During periods of climatic cooling, such as the various ice ages, the land bridge is open for a long time (because sea level remains low) and is usable by cold-adapt species because cool habitats then extend across it. 在气候冷却的时期，如各个冰河时期，陆桥对于适应冷的物种是开放的，因为冷的栖息地那时会延伸到陆桥上。这就意味着，冰河时期的欧亚-非洲陆桥提供了适合冷适应型羚羊物种的栖息地。

其他选项：
It encourages migration from Africa to Eurasia of cold-adapted species of antelope.
原文明确说："Thus during cooling most migrants would be expected to travel toward Africa, which is near the equator, since this is the direction dictated by habitat changes on a cooling Earth."
冷适应的羚羊是从欧亚往非洲迁移，不是从非洲往欧亚迁移。

It allows the survival of warm-adapted species of antelope that might otherwise have gone extinct.
原文并没有提到保住了暖适应物种。反而说在气候冷却时，陆桥主要对冷适应物种有利。而暖适应物种要迁徙，只能在地球变暖而且海平面还没升起来的短暂时间段才行（"Only during the short lag between onset of global temperature change and sea level response can warm-adapted species migrate."）这里根本没讲陆桥让暖适应物种得以生存。

It is more likely to exist early in an ice age than later in an ice age.
原文说的是："During periods of climatic cooling, such as the various ice ages, the land bridge is open for a long time (because sea level remains low)..."在冰河时期，陆桥能长时间保持开放，没有说“早期开放、后期就关闭”的意思。

The habitats it offers change more quickly than do those offered by land bridges during other periods.
原文根本没比较过陆桥栖息地变化的速度。文章只在讲气候变冷时陆桥有凉爽栖息地，适合冷适应动物。并没有说栖息地变化速度快慢的问题。

html:
Although many hypotheses have been proposed to explain why some plant communities are more susceptible than others to invasion by nonnative species, results from field studies have been inconsistent and no general theory of invasibility has yet emerged. However, a theory based on fluctuating resource availability could integrate most existing hypotheses and successfully resolve many of the apparently conflicting and ambiguous results of previous studies. The suggested theory is that a plant community becomes more susceptible to invasion whenever there is an increase in the amount of unused resources.

The diversity in the range of resource-release mechanisms could partly explain the absence of consistent ecological correlates of invasibility. In particular, the theory predicts that there will be no necessary relationship between the species diversity of a plant community and its susceptibility to invasion, since near-complete exploitation can each occur in both species-rich and species-poor communities. Though Lonsdale found a positive association between species richness and invasion, this may arise from the tendency of diverse plant communities to be nutrient poor and therefore more responsive to the effects of human-caused influxes of nutrients.
zh:
①尽管已经提出了许多假说来解释为什么有些植物群落比其他群落更容易受到非本地物种的入侵，但实地研究的结果并不一致，而且尚未出现关于入侵性的一般理论。
②然而，一种基于资源可用性波动的理论可以整合现有的大多数假说，并成功地解决以往研究中许多明显相互矛盾和模棱两可的结果。
③所提出的理论认为，只要未利用资源的数量增加，植物群落就更容易受到入侵。

④资源释放机制的多样性可以部分解释入侵性缺乏一致的生态相关性。
⑤特别是，该理论预测，植物群落的物种多样性与其易受入侵性之间没有必然联系，因为物种丰富和物种贫乏的群落都可能出现近乎完全的开发。
⑥虽然 L发现了物种丰富度和入侵之间的正相关关系，但这可能是由于多样的植物群落趋向于营养贫乏，因此更容易受到人为营养物质输入的影响。

qs.stem: The passage is primarily concerned with
qs.zh: 文章主要涉及

opts.t: assessing the empirical success of a theory
opts.cn: 评估一种理论在实证上的成功与否

opts.t: explaining why no consistent theoretical account of a phenomenon has been possible
opts.cn: 解释为什么不可能对某一现象做出一致的理论解释

opts.t: advocating a potential solution to a theoretical impasse
opts.cn: 提出理论僵局的潜在解决方案

opts.t: deducing testable predictions from a proposed theory
opts.cn: 从提出的理论中推导出可检验的预言

opts.t: describing the difficulties involved in explaining certain empirical results
opts.cn: 描述在解释某些经验结果时遇到的困难

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文章开篇指出现有的各种假说无法一致解释为什么某些植物群落更容易被外来物种入侵。然后，文章介绍了一种基于资源可用性波动的新理论，并认为这种理论可以整合现有的大部分假说，从而解决之前研究结果中的许多矛盾和模糊之处。全文的主旨是提出理论僵局的潜在解决方案，对应C选项。

其他选项：
assessing the empirical success of a theory
文中并没有强调“评估该理论是否已经被实验支持”。
文中说“no general theory … has yet emerged”（还没有成功的统一理论），而后面提出的新理论只是“suggested”。

explaining why no consistent theoretical account of a phenomenon has been possible
文章开头提到“results from field studies have been inconsistent and no general theory…”，但这只是引入问题的背景。
主体部分是介绍新理论来解决这个问题，而不是一直解释为什么之前不行。

deducing testable predictions from a proposed theory
文中虽然有一点点预测，例如“no necessary relationship between species diversity and susceptibility to invasion”，但这只是顺带说明。
文章的重心不是在“推导预测”，而是在“提出理论并说明它的潜在价值”。

describing the difficulties involved in explaining certain empirical results
开头提到过“results from field studies have been inconsistent”，但这只是背景。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that the author would most likely agree with which of the following assessments of the results from field studies
qs.zh: 可以推断，作者最有可能同意以下哪项对实地研究结果的评价

opts.t: Many of the results contradicted predictions of susceptibility to invasion that are based on the availability of resources unused by the community.
opts.cn: 许多结果与根据社区未使用资源的可用性而预测的入侵易感性相矛盾。

opts.t: If fluctuating resource availability were taken into account, many of the apparent inconsistencies among the results could be explained.
opts.cn: 如果考虑到资源可用性的波动，就可以解释许多明显不一致的结果。

opts.t: The apparent inconsistencies and ambiguities in the results are caused by trying to make them fit an inadequate general theory of invasibility.
opts.cn: 结果中明显的不一致性和模糊性是由于试图使它们符合不充分的入侵性一般理论造成的。

opts.t: No general theory of invasibility has emerged because none of the studies has been able to assess the degree of an invasion accurately.
opts.cn: 由于没有一项研究能够准确评估入侵的程度，因此还没有形成关于入侵的一般理论。

opts.t: The results tend to show a degree of susceptibility to invasion that is lower than would be expected given the prevalence in the wild of nonnative species.
opts.cn: 研究结果表明，鉴于非本地物种在野生环境中的普遍存在，入侵的易感程度往往低于预期。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
加粗后一句提到，“However, a theory based on fluctuating resource availability could integrate most existing hypotheses and successfully resolve many of the apparently conflicting and ambiguous results of previous studies.” 这句话明确指出，基于资源波动性的理论可以整合大多数现有假设，并成功解决许多先前研究中明显的冲突和模糊结果，对应B选项。

其他选项：
Many of the results contradicted predictions of susceptibility to invasion that are based on the availability of resources unused by the community.
原文说的是相反方向：“a theory based on fluctuating resource availability could … successfully resolve many of the apparently conflicting and ambiguous results”。也就是说，这个理论可以解释很多矛盾结果，不是被很多结果反驳。

The apparent inconsistencies and ambiguities in the results are caused by trying to make them fit an inadequate general theory of invasibility.
原文只说“no general theory of invasibility has yet emerged”，意思是还没有通用理论；并没有说已有一个“不充分理论”导致了这些问题。

No general theory of invasibility has emerged because none of the studies has been able to assess the degree of an invasion accurately.
原文没有提到“assess the degree of an invasion accurately”。作者给出的解释方向是“资源释放机制很多样”，即 “diversity in the range of resource-release mechanisms could partly explain the absence of consistent ecological correlates of invasibility”，不是测量不准确。

The results tend to show a degree of susceptibility to invasion that is lower than would be expected given the prevalence in the wild of nonnative species.
原文完全没有比较“研究显示的易感性”和“野外外来物种的普遍程度”，也没有说结果偏低。

qs.stem: According to the author, the theory based on fluctuating resource availability might resolve “apparently conflicting and ambiguous results” because
qs.zh: 作者认为，基于资源可用性波动的理论可以解决 "明显矛盾和模糊的结果"，因为

opts.t: It explains how a particular circumstance can produce disparate effects.
opts.cn: 它解释了特定情况如何产生不同的影响。

opts.t: It does not assume that all of the results are instances of the phenomenon that the theory is intended to explain.
opts.cn: 它并不假定所有结果都是该理论所要解释的现象的实例。

opts.t: It predicts that seemingly minor variations in research methodology can have a dramatic effect on results.
opts.cn: 它预测研究方法中看似微小的变化也会对结果产生巨大影响。

opts.t: Its account is based on a statistical tendency rather than on the supposition that the results arise from a causal connection.
opts.cn: 它的解释是基于统计趋势，而不是假设结果是因果联系造成的。

opts.t: It indicates why a similar outcome may be preceded by very different circumstances on different occasions.
opts.cn: 它说明了为什么在不同的场合，类似的结果可能会出现在截然不同的情况下。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
定位第一段最后一句，该理论的内容：The suggested theory is that a plant community becomes more susceptible to invasion whenever there is an increase in the amount of unused resources.
定位第二段第二句，对于该理论的具体展开：In particular, the theory predicts that there will be no necessary relationship between the species diversity of a plant community and its susceptibility to invasion, since near-complete exploitation can each occur in both species-rich and species-poor communities。该理论认为，植物群落在资源增加时变得更容易被入侵。由于不同的资源释放机制，资源增加可能在不同的植物群落中发生，导致相似的入侵结果。
即，该理论解释了在不同的条件下可能会产生相似的结果（植物群落被入侵），对应E选项。

其他选项：
It explains how a particular circumstance can produce disparate effects.
文中并没说“同一情形导致不同结果”，而是说不同情形都可能通向同一结果（被入侵）。证据强调的是多种“resource-release mechanisms”导致结果不一致的相关性，而不是同一情形效果分化。

It does not assume that all of the results are instances of the phenomenon that the theory is intended to explain.
作者并没排除过去研究结果属于“入侵性”现象本身；相反是要整合这些结果（“could integrate most existing hypotheses”）。

It predicts that seemingly minor variations in research methodology can have a dramatic effect on results.
全文都没讨论“方法学差异”，讨论的是生态机制/情境差异（资源释放方式、营养状况、人为营养输入）。

Its account is based on a statistical tendency rather than on the supposition that the results arise from a causal connection.
理论明确给出因果机理：“a plant community becomes more susceptible to invasion whenever there is an increase in the amount of unused resources.”

html:
In 1886 approximately 20 percent of United States workers belonged to the Knights of Labor, a labor-activist fraternal order. Nonetheless, soon after reaching this peak, the Knights membership began a rapid decline, and the organization never regained its national prominence. This collapse had wide-ranging repercussions: subsequent worker organizations took a less active and less broad-based organizational approach. The Knights' defeat demoralized those who championed radical reform and the organization of workers as a class, while empowering those who promoted a less inclusive strategy.

Current scholarship has tended to attribute the Knights calamitous decline to two factors: persistent tension between skilled and unskilled workers, and fierce opposition from employer associations, which used extralegal means to undermine unions. Voss examined both factors and found that employer associations’ opposition, not conflict among the Knights, led to the Knights' rapid decline. But Voss's account fails to explain why the Knights succumbed so easily when other union movements thrived. It seems that the Knights' particular organizational structure prompted factional disputes among members and, more important, that competition from rival trade and fraternal organizations lured members away. While dissension within the order might not itself have suﬃced to cause its demise, the profusion of organizational alternatives during this period induced mass defection, and, subsequently, the transformation of the American labor movement.
zh:
①1886 年，约有 20% 的美国工人加入了劳工活动家兄弟会--劳工骑士团。
②然而，在达到这一顶峰后不久，骑士团的会员人数开始迅速下降，该组织再也没有恢复其在全国的影响力。
③这种崩溃产生了广泛的影响：后来的工人组织采取了一种不那么积极、基础不那么广泛的组织方式。
④骑士团的失败打击了那些倡导激进改革和将工人组织为一个阶级的人的士气，同时也增强了那些倡导包容性较弱的战略的人的力量。

⑤目前的学术研究倾向于将骑士团的灾难性衰落归因于两个因素：技术工人和非技术工人之间持续的紧张关系，以及雇主协会的激烈反对，雇主协会使用法外手段破坏工会。
⑥V研究了这两个因素，发现是雇主协会的反对而不是骑士团之间的冲突导致了骑士团的迅速衰落。
⑦但V的说法未能解释为什么骑士团如此轻易地屈服，而其他工会运动却蓬勃发展。
⑧骑士团特殊的组织结构似乎引发了成员之间的派别纷争，更重要的是，来自竞争对手的贸易和兄弟会组织的竞争吸引了成员的离开。
⑨虽然骑士团内部的不和本身可能不足以导致其消亡，但这一时期大量的组织选择却导致了大规模的叛变，并随之引发了美国劳工运动的变革。

qs.stem: According to the passage, the rapid decline in the Knights of Labor membership resulted in which of the following?
qs.zh: 根据文章，劳工骑士团成员的迅速减少导致了以下哪种情况？

opts.t: Greater prominence of labor activists who advocated a relatively moderate approach to organizing workers
opts.cn: 主张以相对温和的方式组织工人的劳工活动家的地位更加突出

opts.t: Increasing tensions between labor activists who advocated a broad-based approach to organizing workers and those who advocated a less inclusive approach
opts.cn: 主张以基础广泛的方式组织工人的劳工活动家与主张以包容性较小的方式组织工人的劳工活动家之间的关系日益紧张

opts.t: A decline in the number of workers who regarded labor organizing as an eﬀective means of advancing their interests
opts.cn: 认为劳工组织是促进自身利益的有效手段的工人人数减少

opts.t: An increase in the aggressiveness with which employer associations sought to undermine workers' eﬀorts to organize
opts.h: An increase in the aggressiveness with which employer associations sought to undermine workers' eﬀorts to organize
opts.cn: 雇主协会更加积极地破坏工人的组织努力

opts.t: An increase in public concern over the use of extralegal means to undermine workers' eﬀorts to organize
opts.h: An increase in public concern over the use of extralegal means to undermine workers' eﬀorts to organize
opts.cn: 公众更加关注利用法外手段破坏工人组织的行为

qs.label: A
qs.why:
根据“resulted in”定位到第一段末尾：：“The Knights' defeat demoralized those who championed radical reform and the organization of workers as a class, while empowering those who promoted a less inclusive strategy.” 这意味着较为温和的劳动活动家，即那些提倡较少包容策略的人，得到了更大的影响力，对应A选项。

其他选项：
Increasing tensions between labor activists who advocated a broad-based approach to organizing workers and those who advocated a less inclusive approach
文中没有提到“矛盾加剧”。只是说广泛派被打击，不包容派获得力量，没有强调双方对立加剧。

A decline in the number of workers who regarded labor organizing as an effective means of advancing their interests
文中没说“工人整体对工会失去信心”。只说 激进改革派被打击，但不是所有工人。

An increase in the aggressiveness with which employer associations sought to undermine workers' efforts to organize
文中说雇主协会确实反对工会，但没有说因 Knights 崩溃而变得“更激烈”。重点是 Knights 内部结构+竞争组织导致了崩溃。

An increase in public concern over the use of extralegal means to undermine workers' efforts to organize
文章里没有提到公众关注。

qs.stem: The author implies that the”organizations" highlighted in the passage were
qs.zh: 作者暗示，这段话中加粗的 "组织 "

opts.t: strengthened by their adoption of the Knights' organizational structure
opts.h: strengthened by their adoption of the Knights' organizational structure
opts.cn: 通过采用骑士团的组织结构而得到加强

opts.t: weakened by their separation of skilled from unskilled workers
opts.cn: 技术工人与非技术工人的分离削弱了组织的力量

opts.t: more intent than the Knights had been on achieving radical political reforms
opts.cn: 比骑士团更致力于实现激进的政治改革

opts.t: more aggressive than the Knights had been in countering the extralegal strategies used by employer associations
opts.cn: 比骑士团更积极地反击雇主协会使用的法外策略

opts.t: less committed than the Knights had been to including all workers
opts.cn: 不如骑士团那样致力于将所有工人都包括在内

qs.label: E
qs.why:
第一段最后一句说到："The Knights' defeat demoralized those who championed radical reform and the organization of workers as a class, while empowering those who promoted a less inclusive strategy." 骑士团失败后，那些提倡“包容性较低策略”的人得到了更多支持，而不是继续追求把所有工人组织起来。因此，“后续的工人组织”与骑士团相比，在包容所有工人的承诺上并不那么坚定。对应E选项。

其他选项：
strengthened by their adoption of the Knights' organizational structure
文中没说它们“采用”了骑士团的结构；相反，作者指出骑士团的特定结构导致内部分裂（“the Knights' particular organizational structure prompted factional disputes”），不能推出“采用后被加强”。

weakened by their separation of skilled from unskilled workers
“技工/非技工的张力”是学界常见归因之一，但 Voss 认为主因是资方协会反对（“employer associations’ opposition, not conflict among the Knights, led to the Knights' rapid decline.”）。对后续组织是否“按技工/非技工分离而受弱化”并没有证据。

more intent than the Knights had been on achieving radical political reforms
骑士团的失败“demoralized those who championed radical reform”，说明后来组织不更激进。

more aggressive than the Knights had been in countering the extralegal strategies used by employer associations
文中没说后续组织在对抗资方“非法手段”上更强势；只是说资方反对曾导致骑士团下滑（“employer associations… used extralegal means to undermine unions”），并没比较后续组织的对抗力度。

qs.stem: The author would be most likely to agree with which of the following statements about "Current scholarship"?
qs.zh: 作者最有可能同意以下哪些关于“当前学术研究”的说法？

opts.t: It underestimates the extent to which the American labor movement was aﬀected by the decline in influence of the Knights of Labor.
opts.cn: 它低估了美国劳动运动受到“劳工骑士团”影响力下降的程度。

opts.t: It tends to downplay the intensity of the tension between skilled and unskilled workers who belonged to the Knights of Labor
opts.cn: 它往往低调了属于“劳工骑士团”的熟练和非熟练工人之间紧张关系的强度。

opts.t: It oﬀers a more accurate view of the factors that led to the decline of the Knights of Labor than was oﬀered in earlier scholarship.
opts.cn: 它对导致“劳工骑士团”衰落的因素提供了比早期研究更准确的观点。

opts.t: It tends to characterize the organizational structure of the Knights of Labor in ways that obscure its eﬀect on the organization’s decline
opts.cn: 它倾向于以一种模糊其对组织衰落影响的方式描述“劳工骑士团”的组织结构。

opts.t: It fails to identify a key factor that accounts for the decline in membership of the Knights of Labor.
opts.cn: 它未能确定导致“劳工骑士团”成员减少的一个关键因素。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
在这篇文章中，作者讨论了“现有的学术研究”（Current scholarship）对骑士劳工会（Knights of Labor）迅速衰落的解释，并指出当前的学术研究主要归因于两个因素：1. 熟练工人与非熟练工人之间的矛盾；2. 雇主协会的反对。之后，作者提到 V 的研究发现，雇主协会的反对是主要原因，而不是骑士内部的冲突。然而，作者批评说，V 的解释并没有完全解释为什么骑士劳工会比其他工会更容易瓦解。
可以看出，作者认为“现有的学术研究”忽略了一个关键因素，即骑士劳工会的组织结构导致了内部纷争，以及与其他工会和兄弟会的竞争，导致了大量成员的流失。这表明“当前的学术研究”没有识别出骑士劳工会衰退的一个关键原因，对应E选项。

其他选项：
It underestimates the extent to which the American labor movement was affected by the decline in influence of the Knights of Labor.
文章并没有提到“当前学术研究”低估了这种影响力，文章更多是讨论为什么骑士劳工会迅速衰落的原因，而不是其影响的程度。
It tends to downplay the intensity of the tension between skilled and unskilled workers who belonged to the Knights of Labor.
文章并没有说“当前学术研究”低估了熟练工人与非熟练工人之间的矛盾。实际上，文章提到当前学术研究认为这两个群体的矛盾是导致骑士劳工会衰退的主要原因之一。
It offers a more accurate view of the factors that led to the decline of the Knights of Labor than was offered in earlier scholarship.
文章没有直接比较早期和当前学术研究的准确性。相反，作者批评了当前研究未能解释骑士劳工会衰落的全部原因。
It tends to characterize the organizational structure of the Knights of Labor in ways that obscure its effect on the organization’s decline.
文章中明确提到的是，当前的学术研究根本没有提到组织结构的问题，而不是模糊描述。

html: Some historians have recently challenged the “party period paradigm,” the view, advanced by McCormick and others, that political parties—especially the two major parties—in the United States between the years 1835 and 1900 evoked extraordinary loyalty from voters and dominated political life. Voss-Hubbard cites the frequency of third-party eruptions during the period as evidence of popular antipathy to the two-party regime. He correctly credits third parties with helping generate the nineteenth century’s historically high rates of voter turnout by forcing major parties to bolster supporters’ allegiance, lest minor parties siphon off their votes, and with pushing policy demands that the majorparties ignored. Formisano stresses the pervasive record of nonpartisan and anti-party governance at the local level, and women’ s frequent participation in nineteenth-century public life, prior to their enfranchisement, in nonpartisan and antiparty ways as evidence of the limitations of the party period paradigm. Yet McCormick would deny that the existence of antiparty sentiment during the period undermined the paradigm, since he has always acknowledged the residual strength of such sentiment during the nineteenth century. In any case, the strength of the paradigm is its comparative thrust: the contrast it draws between the period in question and earlier and later political eras.
zh:
①一些历史学家最近对 "政党时期范式 "提出了质疑，M等人认为，1835 年至 1900 年间，美国的政党（尤其是两大政党）唤起了选民的非凡忠诚，并主导了政治生活。
②VH列举了这一时期频繁爆发的第三方事件，以此证明民众对两党制的反感。
③他正确地认为，第三党迫使主要政党加强支持者的忠诚度，以免小党蚕食他们的选票，并推动主要政党忽视的政策要求，从而帮助创造了 19 世纪历史上的高投票率。
④F强调了地方上无党派和反党治理的普遍记录，以及妇女在获得选举权之前经常以无党派和反党的方式参与 19 世纪的公共生活，以此证明政党时期范式的局限性。
⑤然而，M否认这一时期反党情绪的存在破坏了这一范式，因为他一直承认这种情绪在 19 世纪的残余力量。
⑥无论如何，这一范式的优势在于它的比较意义：它将有关时期与之前和之后的政治时代进行对比。

qs.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to
qs.zh: 文章的主要目的是

opts.t: correct a common misconception about a historical period
opts.cn: 纠正对某一历史时期的一个常见误解

opts.t: identify a feature of a historical period that has often been overlooked
opts.cn: 确定一个历史时期经常被忽视的特征

opts.t: challenge the validity of evidence used to support a claim
opts.cn: 质疑用于支持某一主张的证据的有效性

opts.t: discuss certain challenges to a particular view
opts.cn: 讨论对某一观点的某些质疑

opts.t: account for a particular feature of historical period
opts.cn: 解释历史时期的某一特征

qs.label: D
qs.why:
文章开头先提出核心对象：“Some historians have recently challenged the ‘party period paradigm’”。
有些历史学家最近开始挑战一种观点：1835 到 1900 年间，美国政党，尤其两大党，极大地吸引选民忠诚并主导政治生活。

接着作者介绍两个挑战者的理由。
Voss-Hubbard 用 “the frequency of third-party eruptions” 作为证据，说明当时有很多第三党兴起，反映民众对两党体制不满。
Formisano 则强调 “nonpartisan and anti-party governance at the local level” 和女性在未获选举权前以非党派、反党派方式参与公共生活，说明这个 paradigm 有局限。

最后作者补充 McCormick 可能的回应：“McCormick would deny that the existence of antiparty sentiment … undermined the paradigm”，因为他本来就承认 19 世纪仍有反党派情绪。
并且最后一句说，这个 paradigm 的强项在于 “comparative thrust”，也就是它主要是在比较 1835–1900 这个时期和更早、更晚时期的不同。

全文主要是在介绍一些历史学家如何挑战 “party period paradigm” 这一观点，同时简单说明这个观点的回应空间和核心强项，对应 D 选项。

其他选项：
correct a common misconception about a historical period
原文主要说的是 “Some historians have recently challenged the ‘party period paradigm’”，也就是介绍某些学者对一个学术观点的挑战；作者并没有明确说这个 paradigm 是“common misconception”，也没有把全文写成“纠错”。

identify a feature of a historical period that has often been overlooked
文中确实提到一些容易被忽视的现象，比如 “third-party eruptions” 和 “nonpartisan and anti-party governance”。
但这些只是学者用来挑战 paradigm 的证据；文章重点不是单独指出某个被忽视的历史特征，而是讨论这些特征如何被用来挑战某个观点。

challenge the validity of evidence used to support a claim
作者没有主要去反驳证据本身。比如文中还说 Voss-Hubbard “correctly credits third parties”，说明作者承认第三党的作用。后面只是说 McCormick 不一定认为这些反党派现象会推翻 paradigm，不是在说证据无效。

account for a particular feature of historical period
文中确实顺带解释了第三党如何帮助造成高投票率：“helping generate … high rates of voter turnout”，但这只是 Voss-Hubbard 观点中的一个细节。全文重点不是解释“高投票率”或某个单一历史特征，而是讨论对 “party period paradigm” 的挑战。

qs.stem: In the context in which it appears, “evoked” most nearly means
qs.zh: 在出现的背景下，“evoked”最接近的意思是

opts.t: elicited
opts.cn: 引起

opts.t: recalled
opts.cn: 召回

opts.t: cited
opts.cn: 引述

opts.t: suggested
opts.cn: 建议

opts.t: elaborated
opts.cn: 详细说明

qs.label: A
qs.why:
"...the view, advanced by McCormick and others, that political parties—especially the two major parties—in the United States between the years 1835 and 1900 evoked extraordinary loyalty from voters and dominated political life." 这句话的意思是：“McCormick 等人提出这样一种观点：在1835到1900年间，美国的政党（特别是两个主要政党）激发了选民非同寻常的忠诚，并主导了政治生活。”
这里的“evoked”是说政党引起了或激发了选民的忠诚，也就是 voters 的 loyalty 是被政党“激发出来的”。
elicited 意思是引起某种情绪、反应或回应，和 “政党激发选民忠诚” 的语境一致。

其他选项：
recalled
这个词意思是“回忆起”，通常用在人或记忆上，不适合用来描述政党对选民的影响。政党不是让选民“想起忠诚”，而是激发忠诚。

cited
是“引用”的意思，通常用于论文、观点等，不合适形容政党对选民的影响。

suggested
表示“建议”或“暗示”，意思太弱，也不是“政党激起忠诚”的意思。

elaborated
意思是“详细说明”，用来解释观点、理论，不符合上下文的“政党激发忠诚”这种情感性、行为性的描述。

qs.stem: Select the sentence in the passage that describes how a historian might reply to attempts to call his theory into question.
qs.zh: 请选出文中描述历史学家如何回应质疑其理论的句子。

opts.t: Some historians have recently challenged the “party period paradigm,” the view, advanced by McCormick and others, that political parties—especially the two major parties—in the United States between the years 1835 and 1900 evoked extraordinary loyalty from voters and dominated political life.
Voss-Hubbard cites the frequency of third-party eruptions during the period as evidence of popular antipathy  to the two-party regime.

He correctly credits third  parties with helping generate the nineteenth century’s historically high rates of voter turnout by forcing major parties to bolster supporters’ allegiance, lest minor parties siphon off their votes, and with pushing policy demands that the majorparties ignored.

Formisano stresses the pervasive record of nonpartisan and anti-party governance at the local level, and women’ s frequent participation in nineteenth-century public life, prior to their enfranchisement, in nonpartisan and antiparty ways as evidence of the limitations of the party period paradigm.

Yet McCormick would deny that the existence of antiparty sentiment during the period undermined the paradigm, since he has always acknowledged  the residual strength  of such sentiment during the nineteenth century.
In any case, the strength of the paradigm is its comparative thrust: the contrast it draws between the period in question and earlier and later political eras.

qs.label: E
qs.why:
要求选择体现一位历史学家对于（针对自己的理论的）质疑的反应。
“Yet McCormick would deny that the existence of antiparty sentimentduring the period undermined the paradigm, since he has always acknowledged theresidual strength of such sentiment during the nineteenth century.”这句话描述了M（一个历史学家）对质疑他的理论的回应方式。
具体来说，M在这段时期存在的反党情绪会削弱他的理论，因为他一直承认在19世纪这种情绪的残余力量。这展示了M如何回应试图质疑他的“政党时期范式”的尝试。

html:
Although it is a well-established fact that people are often biased, the nature of this bias is unclear. The crucial issue boils down to whether or not people detect that they are biased. Sound reasoning requires that people monitor their intuitions [the basis for many biases] for conflict with more logical considerations. According to one view, people would be very bad at this monitoring. Because of lax monitoring, people would simply not detect that their intuitions are invalid. However, others have argued that there is nothing wrong with the detection process. They claim that people have little trouble detecting that their intuitions are not fully warranted; the problem, according to this view, is that these intuitions are so tempting that people fail to discard them.

Clarifying the efficiency of the conflict detection process and the resulting nature of the heuristic [intuitive] bias is crucial for the study of human thinking. Recently, De Neys, Vartanian, and Goel tried to decide between the alternative views by monitoring the activation of the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), a neural region associated with conflict detection, during reasoning. They observed that the neural conflict region was activated when people gave biased responses. This finding provided some preliminary support for the idea that people detect that they are biased. However, settling the debate requires further validation and characterization of the detection process.
zh:
①尽管人们经常有偏见是一个公认的事实，但这种偏见的性质尚不清楚。
②关键问题是人们是否察觉到自己有偏见。
③合理的推理要求人们监督自己的直觉（许多偏见的基础），来发现与更合乎逻辑的考虑的冲突。
④由于监控松懈，人们根本不会发现自己的直觉是无根据的。
⑤然而，其他人则认为检测过程没有问题。
⑥他们声称，人们很容易可以检测到自己的直觉是没有根据的；根据这种观点，问题在于这些直觉是如此诱人，以至于人们无法抛弃它们。

⑦阐明冲突检测过程的效率以及由此产生的启发式[直觉式]偏见的性质对于人类思维的研究至关重要。
⑧最近，DN、V和G试图通过在推理过程中监测前扣带皮层（ACC）的激活来决定不同的观点，ACC是一个与冲突检测相关的神经区域。
⑨他们观察到，当人们做出有偏见的反应时，神经冲突区域就会被激活。
⑩这一发现为人们能发现自己有偏见的想法提供了一些初步支持。
⑪然而，解决这一争论需要对检测过程进行进一步的验证和描述。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that proponents of the view mentioned in the highlighted portion of the passage would be most likely to agree with which of the following assertions about bias?
qs.zh: 可以推断，文章加粗部分提到的观点的支持者最有可能同意以下关于偏见的断言中的哪一个？

opts.t: It need not be seen as invariably conflicting with principles of sound reasoning.
opts.cn: 它不必被视为总是与合理推理的原则相冲突。

opts.t: It is particularly difficult to explain because it is hard to characterize bias.
opts.cn: 它解释起来特别困难，因为很难描述偏见。

opts.t: It does not result from people's unwillingness to relinquish idea that they sense might be inaccurate.
opts.h: It does not result from people's unwillingness to relinquish idea that they sense might be inaccurate.
opts.cn: 这并不是因为人们不愿意放弃他们认为可能不准确的想法。

opts.t: It may be more likely to arise in situations where people have conflicted feelings.
opts.cn: 它可能更容易出现在人们有矛盾情绪的情况下。

opts.t: It is particularly difficult for researchers to identify because people are often lax in monitoring their own biases.
opts.cn: 研究人员尤其难以识别它，因为人们在监测自己的偏见方面往往松懈。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
加粗部分的观点的支持者认为“people would be very bad at this monitoring”，即人们根本意识不到自己的直接和更符合逻辑的观点产生了冲突。后两句（第五句和第六句）是另一个观点，人们能够察觉到自己的偏见，只是不愿抛弃自己的想法。
可以推出加粗部分的观点的支持者是不同意第二个观点的，即他们不认为偏见源于“人们能够察觉到自己的偏见，只是不愿抛弃自己的想法”，对应C选项。

qs.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to
qs.zh: 这篇文章的主要目的是

opts.t: point out a flaw in a particular explanation
opts.cn: 指出某一特定解释中的缺陷

opts.t: present alternative views about a particular issue
opts.cn: 对某一特定问题提出不同的看法

opts.t: identify a common but under recognized tendency
opts.cn: 识别一种常见但未被认识到的趋势

opts.t: explain why a particular hypothesis is difficult to substantiate
opts.cn: 解释为什么一个特定的假设很难被证实

opts.t: evaluate the evidence used to settle a particular question
opts.cn: 评估用于解决特定问题的证据

qs.label: B
qs.why:
文章提到人们是否能检测到自己存在偏见，有两个不同的观点：
一派认为人们很糟糕，基本无法检测到自己的直觉有问题（检测不出来）。
另一派认为，虽然人们能检测到自己的直觉不完全可靠，但这些直觉太诱人了，他们舍不得丢弃。

文章并没有偏向哪一方，而是告诉我们这两种不同的观点，还引用了一些科学家最近的实验，试图用脑部研究来解决问题。因此，文章的主要目的是：展示有关“人们是否能检测到自己的偏见”这一问题的不同观点，对应B选项。

其他选项：
point out a flaw in a particular explanation
文章并没有明确指出哪种观点有错误，而是呈现了两种不同的解释。
identify a common but under recognized tendency
虽然文章讨论了偏见，但它没有在说某种“常见但未被认识的倾向”，而是在探讨人们是否能察觉自己的偏见。
explain why a particular hypothesis is difficult to substantiate
虽然文章提到要进一步研究才能得出结论，但文章的重点不是为什么某个假设难以证实，而是在展示两种不同的观点。
evaluate the evidence used to settle a particular question
文章提到了一个实验，但并没有评估实验的有效性，而只是说实验提供了“初步的支持”。重点是展示两种对立的观点，而不是评估证据。

html:
In river science, as in all sciences, there is an accepted way of analyzing problems. This standardized way of collecting and analyzing data allows a cleaner comparison of results between sites or time periods, or an evaluation of the effectiveness of different management activities. Often this involves a preconceived reference frame for types of problems. What is gained in the efficient production of knowledge, however, is potentially lost for the potential of novel observations.

In the case of sediment transport, during the last century, river scientists have shown much less concern for sediment storage than for sediment movement, even though any given sediment particle is likely to spend centuries to millennia in storage on a floodplain or in bars [submerged banks of sediment] and only days to weeks in actual transport. Meade suggests that were geomorphologists to have focused on individual sediment particles’ movements beyond just the reach [a short, straight segment of a river] scale, emphasis from the research community would have inevitably focused on sediment storage, and thus on the processes that sediment undergoes during storage rather than on the processes of mobilizing sediment. Fluvial geomorphology would probably then have been dominated by studies of chemical weathering rather than fluid mechanics. The preference for Eulerian-based studies of sediment fluxes and the processes that determine those fluxes have arguably biased the research agenda of geomorphologists for several decades.
zh:
①在河流科学中，就像在所有科学中一样，存在一种被广泛接受的分析问题的方式。
②这种收集、分析数据的标准方法使得不同地点、时间的结果比较和不同操作活动的效果评价都更符合规则。
③通常这涉及到对问题类型的预先设定的参考框架。
④然而，通过高效生产知识所获得的收益，可能会损失一些新观察结果的可能性。

⑤在泥沙运移的案例中，过去的一个世纪里，河流科学家对泥沙贮存的关注远远不及泥沙运动，即使每个泥沙颗粒可能在洪泛平原或河流岸边的沉积体中贮存几个世纪甚至几千年，而在实际运输只需要几天到几个星期的时间。
⑥M指出，如果地貌学家不只关注一个泥沙颗粒在一小段河流中的运动，研究界的就会关注到泥沙的储存，而不仅仅只关注运动的泥沙。
⑦河流地貌学可能会被化学风化研究所主导，而不是流体力学研究。
⑧偏好欧拉法的流体力学对于沉积物流动及过程的研究把地貌学带偏了好几个年代。

qs.stem: The author of the passage would most likely agree with which of the following statements about river scientists?
qs.zh: 这篇文章的作者很可能会同意下面关于河流科学家的哪种说法？

opts.t: The emphasis they have placed on particle movements within the reach scale has led to a misuse of Eulerian-based studies.
opts.cn: 他们把重点放在可达范围内的粒子运动上，导致了对欧拉法研究的误用。

opts.t: Their preference for studies of fluid mechanics has given them an inaccurate understanding of the processes sediment undergoes during storage
opts.cn: 他们对流体力学研究的偏好使他们对沉积物在储存过程中所经历的过程有了不准确的理解

opts.t: Their use of multiple preconceived reference frames has led to a distorted view of sediment transport.
opts.cn: 他们使用多个预先设想的参照系，导致了对泥沙运输的扭曲看法。

opts.t: The novel observations about sediment storage they have forgone are offset by their insights into chemical weathering.
opts.cn: 他们放弃的关于沉积物储存的新观察被他们对化学风化的洞察所抵消。

opts.t: The attention they have paid to sediment movement is disproportionate to the amount of time sediment is in motion.
opts.cn: 他们对泥沙运动的关注与泥沙运动的时间不成比例。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
文章的主旨在于批评河流科学家过于专注“沉积物的运动”（sediment movement），而忽视了“沉积物的储存”（sediment storage）。
作者认为这是一个偏颇，因为事实上——“even though any given sediment particle is likely to 【spend centuries to millennia】 in storage on a floodplain or in bars...and only 【days to weeks】 in actual transport.”
沉积物大部分时间都在“储存”状态，而不是“运动”状态，但科学家却更多地研究“运动”。

即，沉积物在运动中的时间远少于在储存中的时间，而研究的关注点却反过来了，是不成比例的，对应E选项。

其他选项：
The emphasis they have placed on particle movements within the reach scale has led to a misuse of Eulerian-based studies.
原文提到这种偏重导致“研究议程受到偏见”（“biased the research agenda”），但没有说“误用”（misuse）Eulerian方法，只是说过度依赖这种视角让研究偏了方向。

Their preference for studies of fluid mechanics has given them an inaccurate understanding of the processes sediment undergoes during storage.
原文并没有说他们的理解“inaccurate”，只是说他们没有重点研究储存过程（i.e. lack of emphasis），不能推出他们的理解错误。

Their use of multiple preconceived reference frames has led to a distorted view of sediment transport.
原文说有一个“preconceived reference frame”（一个预设框架），并没有说“多个”（multiple），也没用“distorted”（扭曲）这种程度强烈的词。

The novel observations about sediment storage they have forgone are offset by their insights into chemical weathering.
原文指出如果他们更重视储存，可能就会研究chemical weathering。这句话是一个假设性的推测（counterfactual），并不是说他们目前有关于化学风化的洞见，也没有“offset”这种平衡的说法。

html:
Few topics engender more controversy among musicologists than the "authentic" performance of music of earlier periods. At issue are claims made by partisans of the early music movement that their performances represent a re-creation of history and that the historical information on which such performances are based provide a sure foundation for performances that accurately reflect the composer's original intentions. Taruskin has been the most powerful critic of this view, arguing that so-called authentic performances do not reveal any concrete truth of how the music of earlier times "should" sound. Instead, these performances reflect our contemporary taste for this repertoire' s sound and offer a twentieth-century interpretation that, while based on certain historical facts, is encumbered with the unconscious biases inherent in any interpretive endeavor.

Yet, despite their flaws, historical investigations and interpretations remain an indispensable part of music scholarship. Indeed, Taruskin is not engaged in a wholesale crusade against the early music movement or against performance-practice research; rather, he is calling for intellectual honesty. His arguments are important because they help clarify the thin line between historical facts, on the one hand, and, on the other, musical interpretations based not only on those facts but also on imaginative, well-founded speculation.
zh:
①在音乐学界，很少有比早期音乐的 "原汁原味 "演奏更能引起争议的话题了。
②早期音乐运动的拥护者声称，他们的演奏是对历史的再现，这些演奏所依据的历史资料为演奏提供了可靠的基础，能够准确反映作曲家的原意。
③T 对这种观点提出了最有力的批评，他认为所谓的原汁原味的表演并不能揭示早期音乐 "应该 "如何听起来的具体真相。
④相反，这些演奏反映了我们当代人对这一曲目音色的喜好，并提供了一种二十世纪的诠释，这种诠释虽然基于某些历史事实，但却带有任何诠释工作中固有的无意识偏见。

⑤然而，尽管存在缺陷，历史调查和诠释仍然是音乐学术不可或缺的一部分。
⑥事实上，T 并不是在全盘讨伐早期音乐运动或表演实践研究；相反，他是在呼吁知识的诚实。
⑦他的论点之所以重要，是因为这些论点有助于澄清历史事实与音乐诠释之间的细微界限，而音乐诠释不仅要基于这些事实，还要基于富有想象力的、有根据的推测。

qs.stem: The passage indicates that Taruskin and the partisans mentioned would both agree with which of the following statements regarding "authentic" performances of early music?
qs.zh: 文章表明，T 和早期音乐运动支持者都同意以下哪种关于早期音乐 "原汁原味 "表演的说法？

opts.t: These performances are unduly influenced by unconscious interpretive biases.
opts.cn: 这些演奏受到无意识的诠释偏见的不当影响。

opts.t: These performances have a basis in historical fact.
opts.cn: 这些表演有史实依据。

opts.t: These performances accurately reflect early music composers' original intentions.
opts.h: These performances accurately reflect early music composers' original intentions.
opts.cn: 这些表演准确地反映了早期音乐作曲家的原意。

opts.t: These performances are based as much on imaginative speculation as on historical fact.
opts.cn: 这些表演既基于历史事实，也基于想象力的推测。

opts.t: These performances are more reflective of our contemporary taste for this repertoire's sound than of the composers' original intentions.
opts.h: These performances are more reflective of our contemporary taste for this repertoire's sound than of the composers' original intentions.
opts.cn: 这些演奏与其说是反映了作曲家的原意，不如说是反映了我们当代人对这一曲目音色的喜好。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
文章指出，尽管T批评了所谓的“真实”表演，并不是揭示早期音乐应该如何听起来的具体真理，但他承认这些表演是基于某些历史事实的。同样，早期音乐运动的支持者也声称他们的表演基于历史信息，并试图通过这些表演重现历史。
因此，双方都同意这些表演有其历史事实的基础，对应B选项。

其他选项：
“These performances are unduly influenced by unconscious interpretive biases.”
Taruskin认为这些表演受到无意识偏见的影响："...these performances... is encumbered with the unconscious biases inherent in any interpretive endeavor."但是，早期音乐运动的支持者不会同意这一点，因为他们认为他们的表演是对历史的再现，准确反映了作曲家的原始意图。

“These performances accurately reflect early music composers' original intentions.”
早期音乐运动的支持者会同意这一点："...their performances represent a re-creation of history and that the historical information on which such performances are based provide a sure foundation for performances that accurately reflect the composer's original intentions."
但是，Taruskin不同意："Taruskin has been the most powerful critic of this view, arguing that so-called authentic performances do not reveal any concrete truth of how the music of earlier times 'should' sound."

“These performances are based as much on imaginative speculation as on historical fact.”
Taruskin可能同意这一点，因为他认为这些表演除了基于历史事实外，还受到解释者的无意识偏见影响。但早期音乐运动的支持者不会同意，他们认为他们的表演准确反映了历史。

”These performances are more reflective of our contemporary taste for this repertoire's sound than of the composers' original intentions.“
Taruskin同意这一点："...these performances reflect our contemporary taste for this repertoire's sound..."
但早期音乐运动的支持者不会同意这一观点。

qs.stem: The passage suggests that the author would agree with which of the following statements about the "unconscious biases" mentioned?
qs.zh: 文章表明，作者同意以下哪种关于 "无意识偏见 "的说法？

opts.t: The role that these biases play in musical interpretation has been exaggerated by critics of the early music movement.
opts.cn: 早期音乐运动的批评者夸大了这些偏见在音乐诠释中的作用。

opts.t: The fact that such biases exist suggests that most twentieth-century interpretations of early music are unsound.
opts.cn: 这些偏见的存在表明，二十世纪对早期音乐的诠释大多是不健全的。

opts.t: These biases make it difficult to clarify the line between historical facts and well-founded speculation.
opts.cn: 这些偏见使我们难以厘清历史事实与有根据的推测之间的界限。

opts.t: These biases are more readily apparent in interpretations of early music than they are in interpretations of music of our own time.
opts.cn: 在对早期音乐的阐释中，这些偏见比在对当代音乐的阐释中更为明显。

opts.t: These biases, while real, do not necessarily negate the usefulness of historical interpretation.
opts.cn: 这些偏见虽然真实存在，但并不一定否定历史解释的有用性。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
定位到加粗所在句和后一句：Instead, these performances reflect our contemporary taste for this repertoire' s sound and offer a twentieth-century interpretation that, while based on certain historical facts, is encumbered with the unconscious biases inherent in any interpretive endeavor.
Yet, despite their flaws, historical investigations and interpretations remain an indispensable part of music scholarship.
这种解释，虽然基于某些历史事实，但被任何解释努力中固有的无意识偏见所拖累。尽管如此，文章也指出尽管存在这些偏见，历史调查和解释仍然是音乐学术研究不可或缺的一部分。
这意味着作者认为，虽然无意识偏见是真实存在的，但这并不一定否定了历史解释的有用性，对应E选项。

其他选项：
The role that these biases play in musical interpretation has been exaggerated by critics of the early music movement.
文章中没有提到这些偏见被“夸大”，也没有说是谁夸大的。

The fact that such biases exist suggests that most twentieth-century interpretations of early music are unsound.
Taruskin 并没有说“most twentieth-century interpretations are unsound”（大多数是不可靠的），他只是说这些演出带有现代品味和偏见，并不是说它们都错误。

These biases make it difficult to clarify the line between historical facts and well-founded speculation.
原文中说："his arguments are important because they help clarify the thin line between historical facts... and... speculation."
也就是说，Taruskin 的批评反而是帮助澄清这条界限，不是说偏见使澄清更困难。

These biases are more readily apparent in interpretations of early music than they are in interpretations of music of our own time.
原文没有做这种比较（early music vs. music of our own time）。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that the author of the passage would be most likely to agree with which of the following assessments of Taruskin's criticisms of the early music movement?
qs.zh: 可以推断，这段文字的作者最有可能同意T对早期音乐运动的批评得以下哪项评估？

opts.t: His criticisms are flawed in that they do not make allowances for the role played by historical investigation and interpretation in music scholarship.
opts.cn: 他的批评有缺陷，没有考虑到历史调查和解释在音乐学术中的作用。

opts.t: His criticisms are undermined by the fact that his own work suffers from the unconscious biases inherent in any interpretive endeavor.
opts.cn: T自己的研究工作也受到任何阐释工作中固有的无意识偏见的影响，这削弱了他的批评。

opts.t: His criticisms are well founded, even if he exaggerates the difficulty of discerning a composer's original intentions.
opts.h: His criticisms are well founded, even if he exaggerates the difficulty of discerning a composer's original intentions.
opts.cn: 尽管他夸大了辨别作曲家原意的难度，但他的批评是有根据的。

opts.t: His criticisms are useful in that they help reveal the limits of historically based research in the interpretation of early music.
opts.cn: 他的批评是有益的，因为这些批评有助于揭示早期音乐诠释中基于历史的研究的局限性。

opts.t: His criticisms are instructive in that they enable performers of early music to re-create historically accurate performances.
opts.cn: 他的批评具有启发性，因为这些批评使早期音乐表演者能够重新创作出符合历史的表演。

qs.label: D
qs.why:
要找作者对T的态度，定位到最后一句：His arguments are important because they help clarify the thin line between historical facts, on the one hand, and, on the other, musical interpretations based not only on those facts but also on imaginative, well-founded speculation.
作者认为他的批评有用，因为它们帮助揭示了在解释早期音乐中基于历史的研究的限制，对应D选项。

其他选项：
His criticisms are flawed in that they do not make allowances for the role played by historical investigation and interpretation in music scholarship.
原文第2段：“Taruskin is not engaged in a wholesale crusade… against performance-practice research”
说明 Taruskin 并没有否认历史研究的重要性，所以这个批评并不存在。

His criticisms are undermined by the fact that his own work suffers from the unconscious biases inherent in any interpretive endeavor.
原文承认 interpretive endeavor 都有偏见，但并没说这削弱了他的观点。

His criticisms are well founded, even if he exaggerates the difficulty of discerning a composer’s original intentions.
文中没有说他“夸大难度”，反而暗示原意很难精准还原（与他观点一致）。

His criticisms are instructive in that they enable performers of early music to re-create historically accurate performances.
Taruskin 的核心观点是不可能完全再现作曲家原意，所以不可能说他的批评能让人做到历史上“准确”的重现。

html: Faced with the paucity of surviving texts by mid-eighteenth-century American women, historians interested in women’s experience have proven resourceful at using nontextual sources. Recently, Laurel Thatcher Ulrich has turned to objects hand-sewn by New England women, maintaining that objects such as sheets, pillowcases, and quilts reveal the “flow of common life” while providing a context for political events. Discerning the historical significance of these handmade objects is not easy, however. Between today and eighteenth-century New England there looms a formidable nineteenth-century mythology that romanticized that earlier, colonial era, with its household production system, as a simpler time of hard work and virtuous self-sufficiency. This myth emerged as compensation for the extreme wealth and poverty generated by industrialization. As household production declined, and factory-made, store-bought goods became widespread, antiquarians avidly collected and displayed the handmade objects of their idealized forebears. Attentive to the ideological distortions of nineteenth-century mythmaking, most historians are wary of trying to discern the original meaning of colonial objects, assuming that, nowadays, such objects reveal more about nineteenth-century collectors than about eighteenth-century users. By contrast, rather than disparaging the mythmakers, Ulrich thanks them for saving so many objects made and used by ordinary women.
zh:
①面对18世纪中期美国女性现存文本的匮乏，对女性经历感兴趣的历史学家已经证明在使用非文本来源方面足智多谋。
②最近，LTU转向了新英格兰女性手工缝制的物品，认为床单、枕套和被子等物品揭示了“共同生活的流动”，同时为政治事件提供了背景。
③然而，要辨别这些手工制品的历史意义并不容易。
④从今天到18世纪的新英格兰，隐约出现了一个令人敬畏的19世纪神话，它将早期的殖民时代及其家庭生产系统浪漫化为一个更简单的辛勤工作和道德自给自足的时代。
⑤这个神话是对工业化所产生的极端财富和贫困的补偿。
⑥随着家庭生产的减少，工厂制造、商店购买的商品变得普遍，古董商们狂热地收集和展示他们理想化的祖先的手工制品。
⑦由于注意到19世纪神话创作的意识形态扭曲，大多数历史学家对试图辨别殖民地物品的原意持谨慎态度，认为如今，这些物品更多地表现了19世纪的收藏家，而不是18世纪的使用者。
⑧相比之下，U并没有贬低神话制造者，而是感谢他们保存了这么多普通女性制作和使用的物品。

qs.stem: The passage identifies which of the following as a source of difficulty for historians attempting to draw conclusions from the hand-sewn objects referred to in the passage?
qs.zh: 这篇文章指出，以下哪一项是历史学家试图从文章中提到的手工缝制的物品中得出结论的困难来源？

opts.t: The relative shortage of such objects in comparison with other handmade objects
opts.cn: 与其他手工制品相比，此类物品相对短缺

opts.t: Historians insufficient understanding of the household production system that produced these objects
opts.cn: 历史学家对生产这些物品的家庭生产系统了解不足

opts.t: Historians disagreements over why such objects became especially prized during the nineteenth century
opts.cn: 历史学家对为什么这些物品在19世纪变得特别珍贵存在分歧

opts.t: An interpretive context applied to these objects during the nineteenth century
opts.cn: 十九世纪应用于这些物体的解释语境

opts.t: A lack of textual sources that might supplement and explain such objects
opts.cn: 缺乏可以补充和解释这些对象的文本来源

qs.label: D
qs.why:
定位到原文描述历史学家的困难的句子，在倒数第二句（第⑦句）：Attentive to the ideological distortions of nineteenth-century mythmaking, most historians are wary of trying to discern the original meaning of colonial objects, assuming that, nowadays, such objects reveal more about nineteenth-century collectors than about eighteenth-century users. 由于注意到19世纪神话创作的意识形态扭曲，大多数历史学家对试图辨别殖民地物品的原意持谨慎态度，认为如今，这些物品更多地表现了19世纪的收藏家，而不是18世纪的使用者。
也就是说，19世纪出现的神话意识风潮是影响结论辨别这些手工制品的历史意义的重要因素，对应D选项。

qs.stem: Regarding the “myth,” it can be inferred that Ulrich would probably disagree with most historians over
qs.zh: 关于“神话”，可以推断U可能在以下哪点与大多数历史学家意见相左

opts.t: the extent to which this myth interferes with the use of certain objects as historical source material
opts.cn: 这个神话在多大程度上干扰了某些物体作为历史资料的使用

opts.t: the extent to which this myth emerged in response to forces unleashed by industrialization
opts.cn: 这个神话在多大程度上是对工业化释放的力量的回应

opts.t: whether this myth contains clues to the original meaning of handmade objects from the colonial period
opts.cn: 这个神话是否包含殖民时期手工艺品的原始含义的线索

opts.t: whether this myth was especially widespread during the nineteenth century
opts.cn: 这个神话在19世纪是否特别普遍

opts.t: whether this myth was able to compensate adequately for the inequities of industrialization
opts.cn: 这个神话是否能够充分弥补工业化的不公平

qs.label: A
qs.why:
大多数历史学家的观点："Most historians are wary of trying to discern the original meaning of colonial objects, assuming that, nowadays, such objects reveal more about nineteenth-century collectors than about eighteenth-century users."大多数历史学家认为，这些手工制品现在更反映19世纪收藏者的偏见，而不是18世纪使用者的实际情况。

Ulrich 的观点："Rather than disparaging the mythmakers, Ulrich thanks them for saving so many objects made and used by ordinary women."U 并不批评19世纪的“神话创造者”，反而感谢他们保存了这些手工制品。

原文提到，大多数历史学家认为，19世纪对殖民时代的浪漫化使得今天很难通过手工制品了解18世纪的真实历史。然而，U 的观点是，她感谢19世纪的神话创造者保存了这些手工制品。两者分歧在于神话对手工制品的历史意义的干扰程度（大多数历史学家认为神话妨碍了我们理解这些物品的18世纪意义，U的态度是影响相对没那么大，甚至有积极作用），对应A选项。

其他选项：
the extent to which this myth emerged in response to forces unleashed by industrialization
原文提到："This myth emerged as compensation for the extreme wealth and poverty generated by industrialization."
大多数历史学家和 Ulrich 都承认神话与工业化有关，因此这里没有分歧。

whether this myth contains clues to the original meaning of handmade objects from the colonial period
原文没有表明 Ulrich 和其他历史学家是否对这个问题有分歧。

whether this myth was especially widespread during the nineteenth century
原文没有提到 Ulrich 和其他历史学家对19世纪神话的流行程度有不同看法。

whether this myth was able to compensate adequately for the inequities of industrialization
原文提到神话是“补偿”（compensation）工业化带来的不平等，但没有讨论其是否“充分弥补”，也没有显示分歧。

qs.stem: The passage is primarily concerned with discussing
qs.zh: 这篇文章主要涉及讨论

opts.t: reasons that it is difficult to find sources relevant to women’s past experience
opts.cn: 很难找到与女性过去经历相关的资料来源的原因

opts.t: the emergence of a particular historical myth during the mid-nineteenth century
opts.cn: 十九世纪中期一个特定历史神话的出现

opts.t: attitudes regarding the usefulness of certain historical sources for studying a particular period
opts.cn: 关于某些历史资料对研究特定时期有用性的态度

opts.t: attempts by a historian to discern the significance of certain handmade objects
opts.cn: 历史学家辨别某些手工制品的意义的尝试

opts.t: a debate among historians regarding the experience of women during a particular historical period
opts.cn: 历史学家之间关于特定历史时期女性经历的争论

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文章首句提到了利用非文本来源研究18世纪女性经历。第二句给出一个例子：LTU研究女性手工缝制的物品。
后文开始讨论历史学家对于这些手工制品的历史意义的不同态度：多数历史学家持谨慎态度，但是U认为这些物品还是重要的。
全文主要讨论的是历史学家们关于手工制品对于研究18世纪女性经历的有用性的态度，对应C选项。

其他选项：
reasons that it is difficult to find sources relevant to women’s past experience
确实文章一开始提到“文本资料稀少”，但那只是引入背景，不是全文重点。

the emergence of a particular historical myth during the mid-nineteenth century
神话的出现确实有提到，但只是为了说明为什么理解手工物品的历史意义很难，并不是文章主旨。

attempts by a historian to discern the significance of certain handmade objects
Ulrich 是一个例子，但文章不是单讲她的努力，而是将她的态度与其他历史学家对比。

a debate among historians regarding the experience of women during a particular historical period
这篇文章并不是在讨论女性经历的具体内容，而是在讲如何研究女性的经历（通过物品），以及对这些研究材料有效性的不同态度。

html:
Ethnographers have debated whether early-sixteenth-century feasts on the Indonesian island of Nias represented what Beatty refers to as “challenge” feasts. In a competitive or challenge feast, a primary goal was to achieve political domination through an ever-escalating cycle of feasting one-upmanship and public displays of generosity/hostility toward rival chiefs, surpassing the abilities of political rivals to amass, display, distribute and, in some cases, destroy property. Numerous ethnographers cite the massive pig slaughters and ostentatious gifts of gold ornamentation as evidence of the strongly competitive ethos of Nias feasts. However, other ethnographers claim that overtly antagonistic feasts were historically rare in Nias society, that most feasts had highly reciprocal ethos in which enhanced status was transitory, and that social merit and political legitimacy were gained only slowly over the course of an individual's lifetime of ceremonial exchanges.

Some of the contention derives from lack of clarity in distinguishing feasts in which the social merit transacted is transitory and reciprocal from those in which the aim is to accumulate permanent wealth and long-term, inheritable political power . Feasts that confer social merit but are not overtly competitive occur in cycles of balanced reciprocity, in which surplus accumulation and status enhancement for any individual or kin group are transitory and eventually negated through the necessity of reciprocal exchanges with partners in the feasting cycle. In competitive feasts, there is an escalation of labor mobilization and of the surplus that is needed to finance future feasts, with the aim of translating feasting success into long-term political power and economic profit.
zh:
①学者们一直在争论16世纪早期在印度尼西亚尼亚斯岛上举行的宴会是否代表了B所说的“挑战”宴会。
②在竞争性的挑战盛宴中，一个主要目标是通过不断升级的循环来实现政治统治，这种循环是通过大快朵颐，公开表现出对敌对首领的敌视，超越政治对手的聚集、展示、分配的能力，在某些情况下还破坏财产。
③许多民族志学者引用大量的猪屠宰和炫耀性的黄金装饰礼物作为尼亚斯盛宴的强烈竞争精神的证据。
④然而，其他民族志学者声称，在尼亚斯社会中，公开对抗性的宴会在历史上是罕见的，大多数宴会具有高度互惠的精神，在这种精神中，地位的提高是暂时的，社会价值和政治合法性只是在个人一生的礼仪交流过程中缓慢获得的。

⑤一些争论源于在区分宴会时缺乏明确性，在某些宴会中，所交易的社会价值是暂时的和互惠的，而在另一些宴会中的目的是积累永久财富和长期的、可继承的政治权力。
⑥授予社会价值但不具有明显竞争性的宴席发生在平衡互惠的循环中，在这种循环中，任何个人或亲属群体的剩余积累和地位提升都是暂时的，最终由于宴席循环中必须与伙伴进行互惠交换而被否定。
⑦在竞争性宴会中，劳动力动员和未来宴会所需的盈余不断增加，目的是将宴会的成功转化为长期政治权力和经济利润。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that the author would agree that which of the following is true of the "inheritable political power" mentioned in the passage?
qs.zh: 可以推断，关于文中提到的“可继承的政治权力”, 作者会同意以下哪一项？

opts.t: It is typically based on social merit acquired without overt competition.
opts.cn: 它通常基于在没有公开竞争的情况下获得的社会价值

opts.t: It is generally maintained through cycles of balanced reciprocity.
opts.cn: 它通常通过平衡互惠循环来维持

opts.t: Its accumulation represents defining goal of a competitive feast.
opts.cn: 它的积累代表了竞争盛宴的目标

opts.t: It can be gained only slowly,through a lifetime of participation in competitive feasting.
opts.cn: 只有通过一生参与竞争性的宴会，才能慢慢地获得它

opts.t: It has been as rare in Nias society as antagonistic feasts have been.
opts.cn: 在N的社会里，这和对抗性的宴会一样罕见

qs.label: C
qs.why:
加粗部分所在的句子是对两种feast的区分: 一种是"social merit transacted is transitory and reciprocal "，即后一句(第六句说的"confer social merit but are not overtly competitive"), 另一种是" the aim is to accumulate permanent wealth and long-term, inheritable political power", 即最后一句说的"competitive feasts"。
加粗部分就是competitive feasts的aim之一, 对应C选项。

其他选项：
It is typically based on social merit acquired without overt competition.
文中已明确指出取得长期继承的政治权力是通过竞争性盛宴取得的，这种盛宴本身就带有对抗和竞争特征。

It is generally maintained through cycles of balanced reciprocity.
文中明确表示“平衡互惠的循环”是指非竞争型盛宴的特征，与可继承政治权力无关。可继承的政治权力与竞争盛宴相关。

It can be gained only slowly, through a lifetime of participation in competitive feasting.
文中指出慢慢积累、只获短暂声誉的是非竞争型盛宴；而竞争型盛宴则强调的是长期、可继承的权力积累，不一定是“only slowly”获得，而且原文没有表示必须长期累积才能获得这一权力。

It has been as rare in Nias society as antagonistic feasts have been.
文中只是指出民族志学家对盛宴性质的争论，没有说可继承的政治权力很罕见。

html: Ecologists had assumed that trees in the consistently warm tropics grew at a slow but steady rate, unvarying from year to year. However, a study at La Selva, Costa Rica, showed that trees grew less in hotter years and more in cooler ones: between 1984 and 2000, dramatic differences occurred in the six species of trees studies, with trees adding twice as much wood in some cooler years as they did in the scorching El Nino year of 1997-1998. Because tree growth is an index of the balance between photosynthesis, in which trees absorb carbon dioxide (CO2) from the atmosphere and release oxygen, and respiration, in which the opposite occurs, the La Selva data were the first hint that rapidly rising global temperatures, driven by human-generated emissions of CO2, may be pushing tropical forests to release more CO2, thereby intensifying global warming. This raised serious questions about a popular theory that tropical forests act as a sponge, soaking up much of the excess CO2 that humans pump into the atmosphere. The La Selva data are consistent with a model of global CO2 flux developed by Keeling, who concluded that the amount of CO2 taken up in tropical landmasses rose in cooler years and fell in hotter ones, accounting for year-to-year changes in the amount of CO2 that stays in the atmosphere.
zh:
①生态学家曾认为，在持续温暖的热带地区，树木的生长速度缓慢但稳定，每年都不变。
②然而，哥斯达黎加LS的一项研究表明，树木在较热的年份生长较少，在较冷的年份生长较多：1984年至2000年间，研究的六种树木出现了显著差异，在某些较冷的年份，树木的木材增长是1997年至1998年的炎热厄尔尼诺年份的两倍。
③由于树木生长是光合作用和呼吸作用之间平衡的指标（在光合作用中，树木从大气中吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气，而在呼吸作用中，情况正好相反），LS的数据首次表明，由人类产生的二氧化碳排放驱动的全球气温迅速上升，可能会促使热带森林释放更多的二氧化碳，从而加剧全球变暖。
④这引发了人们对一种流行理论的严重质疑，即热带森林就像海绵一样，吸收了人类向大气中排放的大部分过量二氧化碳。
⑤LS的数据与K开发的全球二氧化碳通量模型一致，K得出的结论是，热带陆地吸收的二氧化碳量在较冷的年份上升，在较热的年份下降，这解释了留在大气中的二氧化碳量的逐年变化。

qs.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to
qs.zh: 本文的主要目的是

opts.t: present additional evidence to support a popular theory
opts.cn: 提供额外证据以支持一个流行理论

opts.t: show the underlying similarities of two seemingly contradictory theories
opts.cn: 展示两个看似矛盾理论的潜在相似性

opts.t: point out the implications of a particular study for two related theories
opts.cn: 指出一项特定研究对两个相关理论的影响

opts.t: provide an alternative explanation for a well-documented phenomenon
opts.cn: 为一个有充分证据的现象提供另一种解释

opts.t: reconcile two competing theories that explain a phenomenon
opts.cn: 调和两个解释一个现象的相互竞争理论

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文章讨论了 La Selva 的研究发现，这些数据对两个相关理论产生了影响：
1. 热带森林是否是吸收 CO2 的“海绵”（popular theory）。
2. Keeling 的全球 CO2 流动模型。
从文章内容看，研究结果挑战了第一个理论（即热带森林作为 CO2 海绵的作用），但与 Keeling 的模型是一致的。说明这项研究对这两个理论都具有重要意义，对应C选项。

其他选项：
present additional evidence to support a popular theory
La Selva 的数据对“热带森林作为 CO2 海绵”的理论提出了质疑，不是支持。（“This raised serious questions about a popular theory...”）

show the underlying similarities of two seemingly contradictory theories
文章没有提到两个理论是矛盾的，也没有讨论它们之间的相似性，而是讨论了一个理论受到质疑，另一个理论得到支持。

provide an alternative explanation for a well-documented phenomenon
文章没有提供“替代解释”。是在现有理论框架下，讨论研究对理论的挑战和支持。

reconcile two competing theories that explain a phenomenon
文章没有调和两个理论的冲突，也没有提到它们在竞争解释同一个现象。

qs.stem: The passage suggests that as temperatures rise, trees in the tropical regions
qs.zh: 这段文字表明，随着气温的升高，热带地区的树木

opts.t: continue to grow at a slow but steady rate
opts.cn: 继续以缓慢但稳定的速度增长

opts.t: grow less and intensify photosynthesis
opts.cn: 生长较少，光合作用增强

opts.t: emit more CO2 and oxygen
opts.cn: 排放更多的二氧化碳和氧气

opts.t: increase overall respiration and decrease overall photosynthesis
opts.cn: 整体呼吸增加，整体光合作用减少

opts.t: grow more and absorb more CO2
opts.cn: 生长更多，吸收更多的二氧化碳

qs.label: D
qs.why:
根据题干“as temperatures rise”定位到第三句：Because tree growth is an index of the balance between photosynthesis, in which trees absorb carbon dioxide (CO2) from the atmosphere and release oxygen, and respiration, in which the opposite occurs, the La Selva data were the first hint that rapidly rising global temperatures, driven by human-generated emissions of CO2, may be pushing tropical forests to release more CO2, thereby intensifying global warming.
第三句说“rapidly rising global temperatures may be pushing tropical forests to release more CO2”，气温上升可能会促使热带森林释放更多的二氧化碳。结合第三句开头说“trees absorb carbon dioxide (CO2) from the atmosphere and release oxygen, and respiration, in which the opposite occurs”，树呼吸作用释放二氧化碳，光合作用吸收二氧化碳，推出当温度上升时，树木呼吸作用增加，光合作用减少，对应D选项。

html: Stylistic analysis of ancient works of visual art can help in determining their time and place of origin. It is therefore important to identify the elements that constitute style and their relative value for establishing relationships among artworks. Most helpful in this regard is Schapiro's breakdown of style into the three properties of art: form elements, form relationships, and qualities (including overall expression). Particularly helpful is his distinction between the first two categories. Citing the wide distribution over time of pointed and rounded arches in architecture, for example, Schapiro points out that form elements alone are insufficient for characterizing a style: one must also look at the different ways that the elements are combined-the compositional pattern or syntax. He compares style directly to language, as having a similar internal order and expressiveness; this order (or grammar) can distinguish one stylistic group from another. The way visual motifs are articulated and combined is crucial when dealing with themes that are shared by a number of different cultures contemporary with one another. As Winter has noted, subject matter or iconography then becomes much less important than style in determining the place of origin of a particular artwork.
zh:
