虽然文章提到了Gance和L'Herbier，但并没有提到其他导演的成就。
"It underestimates the degree to which certain French directors were influenced by their Hollywood counterparts during the 1920s."
文章并没有提到法国导演在1920年代受好莱坞导演的影响，讨论的是法国电影未采用好莱坞惯例的原因。
"It is equally as valid as the traditional view of 1920s French cinema."
文章并没有说“this claim”与传统观点一样有效，反而指出它“overestimates or distorts”法国电影的成就。
"It has more merit than other recent, competing assessments of 1920s French cinema."
文章没有对比“this claim”和其他最近的评价。

qs.stem: The author of the passage states which of the following about the French cinema of the 1920s?
qs.zh: 关于 20 世纪 20 年代的法国电影，作者指出了以下哪一点？

opts.t: The visual style of the films is more indebted to Hollywood conventions than many critics recognize.
opts.cn: 这些电影的视觉风格比许多评论家所承认的更多地借鉴了好莱坞的传统。

opts.t: The achievements of the films in terms of visual style might have been greater if the directors had had the production resources available in Hollywood.
opts.cn: 如果导演们拥有好莱坞的制作资源，电影在视觉风格方面的成就可能会更大。

opts.t: The content and ideology of the films were influenced by nineteenth-century art and literature.
opts.cn: 影片的内容和意识形态受到 19 世纪艺术和文学的影响。

opts.t: The films would have been more successful aesthetically had their conventional subject matter not been at odds with their unconventional visual style.
opts.cn: 如果这些影片的传统题材没有与其非常规的视觉风格相冲突，那么它们在美学上会更加成功。

opts.t: The influence of nineteenth-century art on the visual style of the films differentiates them from Hollywood films of the same era.
opts.cn: 十九世纪艺术对影片视觉风格的影响使其有别于同时期的好莱坞电影。

qs.label: C
qs.why:
原文说“十九世纪的艺术与文学对这些影片有着难以忽视的影响——尤其在题材与意识形态假设上”（“the weight of nineteenth-century traditions of art and literature on these films—especially in subject matter and ideological assumptions—cannot easily be disregarded”）。所以作者主张：1920 年代法国电影在内容与意识形态上受十九世纪传统影响，对应 C选项。

其他选项：
The visual style of the films is more indebted to Hollywood conventions than many critics recognize
原文并没说其视觉风格受好莱坞影响，反而强调它们轻视好莱坞惯例，而且这些惯例在法国“尚未完全建立”（“the Hollywood conventions they did not use were not yet fully established in France …”）。

The achievements of the films in terms of visual style might have been greater if the directors had had the production resources available in Hollywood
文中只说明法国缺乏“好莱坞式的生产实践”（“the Hollywood-style production practices … were lacking”），并没推断如果有资源就会更出色。

The films would have been more successful aesthetically had their conventional subject matter not been at odds with their unconventional visual style
原文没有说“题材与风格相冲突”或因此影响“审美成功”；只指出十九世纪传统对题材与意识形态的影响。

The influence of nineteenth-century art on the visual style of the films differentiates them from Hollywood films of the same era
原文把十九世纪传统的影响限定在“题材与意识形态假设”，并没说影响的是视觉风格（同引文：“… especially in subject matter and ideological assumptions …”）。

html: Federal courts in the United States, especially before the famous 1962 case of Baker v. Carr, were often thought to be powerless in the area of election law, voting rights, and other legal questions clearly bearing on politics. This perception was not entirely correct, of course, as pre-1962 Supreme Court decisions such as that in the case of Smith v. Allwright demonstrated: in the wake of that decision, voting participation among African Americans in the South increased substantially. However, political rights had not always been so clearly championed by the Supreme Court as they were in Smith v. Allwright. Indeed, the transformations between the Civil War and 1962 were such that, in reviewing voters’ rights cases over the intervening decades, one feels like an archaeologist cutting through distinct layers in which the judicial decisions uncovered reveal a pattern of ideological and societal change.
zh:
①在美国，特别是在1962年著名的BC案之前，联邦法院在选举法、投票权和其他明显涉及政治的法律问题上，常被认为是无能为力的。
②当然，这种看法并不完全正确，正如1962年前最高法院的裁决，如SA案所表明的那样：在该裁决之后，南方非裔美国人的投票参与率大幅增加。
③然而，政治权利并不总是像在SA案中那样被最高法院明确支持。
④事实上，从南北战争到1962年的变革是如此之大，以至于在回顾几十年间的选民权利案件时，人们会感觉像是一名考古学家，切穿不同层次，所揭露的司法决定显现出一种意识形态和社会变革的模式。

qs.stem: Which of the following can be inferred regarding the case of Baker v. Carr?
qs.zh: 关于BC案，可以推断出以下哪一项？

opts.t: Its outcome required clarification in subsequent decisions rendered by the Supreme Court.
opts.cn: 其结果需要在最高法院随后作出的裁决中予以澄清。

opts.t: Its resolution attested to the power of federal courts to address legal issues related to politics.
opts.cn: 其决议证明了联邦法院有权解决与政治有关的法律问题。

opts.t: It marked a radical change in judicial thinking in the United States.
opts.cn: 这标志着美国司法思想的根本转变。

opts.t: It was decided before the Supreme Courts heard the case of Smith v. Allwright.
opts.cn: 这是在最高法院审理史密斯诉奥尔赖特案之前作出的裁决。

opts.t: It has little historical significance aside from its focus on laws affecting politics.
opts.cn: 除了关注影响政治的法律之外，它几乎没有什么历史意义。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
Federal courts in the United States, especially before the famous 1962 case of Baker v. Carr, were often thought to be powerless in the area of election law, voting rights, and other legal questions clearly bearing on politics.
在1962年Baker v. Carr之前，人们常认为联邦法院在选举法、投票权等政治法律问题上是没有权力的。
然后作者说这个看法不完全正确，“Baker v. Carr 是一件著名的分水岭案件”，暗示它标志着联邦法院在处理政治相关法律问题上的地位变化或能力确认。
所以我们推出，Baker v. Carr 的结果证明了联邦法院有权力处理与政治相关的问题。对应B选项你。

其他选项：
Its outcome required clarification in subsequent decisions rendered by the Supreme Court.
原文中没有提到这个案子之后需要再澄清，也没有提到后续判决与之相关。

It marked a radical change in judicial thinking in the United States.
太绝对。原文虽然提到1962年前后法院在政治案件上的处理态度发生变化，但没有说是radical change（剧烈转变）。而且作者用的是“like an archaeologist cutting through distinct layers”，强调的是逐渐的变化，不是突然的剧烈改变。

It was decided before the Supreme Court heard the case of Smith v. Allwright.
原文说的是：as pre-1962 Supreme Court decisions such as that in the case of Smith v. Allwright demonstrated...
before the famous 1962 case of Baker v. Carr...
说明 Smith v. Allwright 是在 Baker v. Carr 之前发生的，不是之后。

It has little historical significance aside from its focus on laws affecting politics.
作者称它是“the famous 1962 case of Baker v. Carr”，还把它当作联邦法院权力讨论的转折点。说明它的历史意义很大，并不“little”。

qs.stem: The author of the passage uses the analogy of the archaeology most probably in order to
qs.zh: 作者使用考古学的比喻最可能是为了

opts.t: contrast judicial decisions made after 1962 concerning voters rights with decision made immediately after the Civil War
opts.cn: 对比1962年之后关于选民权利的司法裁决与南北战争后的决定

opts.t: suggest that the author is perplexed by many judicial decisions regarding voters’ rights
opts.cn: 表明作者对于关于选民权利的许多司法决定感到困惑

opts.t: characterize the nature of change in judicial thinking regarding voters’ rights
opts.cn: 描述司法在选民权利方面思维变化的性质

opts.t: indicate that much of the history of voters’ rights has been lost since the Civil War
opts.cn: 指出南北战争以来选民权利的大部分历史已经消失

opts.t: illustrate the lack of concern for voters’rights exhibited by federal courts before the Civil War
opts.cn: 说明南北战争前联邦法院对选民权利缺乏关注

qs.label: C
qs.why:
定位到考古学的比喻的句子（最后一句）：Indeed, the transformations between the Civil War and 1962 were such that, in reviewing voters’ rights cases over the intervening decades, one feels like an archaeologist cutting through distinct layers in which the judicial decisions uncovered reveal a pattern of ideological and societal change.” 这句话通过将审查选民权利案件的过程比喻为考古学家切割不同层次，展示出在司法决策中的意识形态和社会变化的模式，从而描述了关于选民权利的司法思维的变化。

其他选项：
contrast judicial decisions made after 1962 concerning voters’ rights with decision made immediately after the Civil War
文章没有对比“1962 之后”和“内战刚结束后的判例”。作者只是说从 内战到1962 这段时间里判例像层层土层，不是专门对比这两个点。

suggest that the author is perplexed by many judicial decisions regarding voters’ rights
“one feels like an archaeologist … reveal a pattern” 说明有规律可循，而不是感到困惑。

indicate that much of the history of voters’ rights has been lost since the Civil War
作者说“像考古学家挖掘层层土层”，不是说“这些层丢失了”。

illustrate the lack of concern for voters’ rights exhibited by federal courts before the Civil War
文章讨论的是 内战之后到1962 的判例。完全没有涉及“内战之前”。题干也说的是 “between the Civil War and 1962”。

qs.stem: The author of the passage is primarily concerned with
qs.zh: 这篇文章的作者主要关心

opts.t: analyzing the sources of a disagreement
opts.h: analyzing the sources of a disagreement
opts.cn: 分析分歧的根源

opts.h: criticizing the past decisions of a court system

opts.h: evaluating the impact of a set of judicial decisions
opts.cn: 评估一系列司法裁决的影响

opts.h: comparing two dissimilar approaches to the study of a discipline
opts.cn: 比较两种不同的学科研究方法

opts.t: commenting on an aspect of United States judicial history
opts.h: commenting on an aspect of United States judicial history
opts.cn: 评论美国司法史的一个方面

qs.label: E
qs.why:
作者讨论了联邦法院在选举法、投票权和其他政治相关法律问题上的角色，尤其是在1962年BC案之前的情况。他提到了如SA案这样的决定对投票权的影响，以及自南北战争以来至1962年间的变化。通过这些讨论，作者展示了美国司法历史的一部分，对应E选项。

其他选项：
analyzing the sources of a disagreement
文章并没有写“某些人A和某些人B有不同意见”。虽然有“perception was not entirely correct”，但那不是在分析分歧，而是在纠正一个误解。

criticizing the past decisions of a court system
作者没有批评。相反，他承认有些判决（如 Smith v. Allwright）推动了积极的变化。文章整体语气是客观、描述性的，而非批判性的。

evaluating the impact of a set of judicial decisions
部分对，但不够精确。文章不仅在“评估影响”，更强调了这些判决如何在历史进程中层层展开，反映社会意识形态的演变。C选项 过于狭窄。

comparing two dissimilar approaches to the study of a discipline
文章没有谈什么“approaches to study”。“archaeologist cutting through layers”只是一个比喻，不是真正的方法论比较。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that the author of the passage believes the record of judicial decisions regarding voters' rights between the Civil War and 1962 to have been
qs.zh: 可以推断，这篇文章的作者认为，南北战争至1962年间关于选民权利的司法判决记录

opts.t: inconsistent with the record of judicial decisions regarding related political issues
opts.h: inconsistent with the record of judicial decisions regarding related political issues
opts.cn: 与有关政治问题的司法裁决记录不一致

opts.t: unlikely to be helpful in arguing present-day cases
opts.h: unlikely to be helpful in arguing present-day cases
opts.cn: 不太可能对现在的案件有帮助

opts.t: counter to the principles upheld in the case of Baker v. Carr
opts.h: counter to the principles upheld in the case of Baker v. Carr
opts.cn: 与贝克诉卡尔案中坚持的原则背道而驰

opts.t: a reflection of the lack of federal court jurisdiction over cases bearing on politics
opts.h: a reflection of the lack of federal court jurisdiction over cases bearing on politics
opts.cn: 是联邦法院对政治案件缺乏管辖权的反思

opts.t: an indication of the evolution of society's ideas
opts.h: an indication of the evolution of society's ideas
opts.cn: 是社会观念演变的标志

qs.label: E
qs.why:
根据时间点定位到最后一句话：However, political rights had not always been so clearly championed by the Supreme Court as they were in Smith v. Allwright. Indeed, the transformations between the Civil War and 1962 were such that, in reviewing voters’ rights cases over the intervening decades, one feels like an archaeologist cutting through distinct layers in which the judicial decisions uncovered reveal a pattern of ideological and societal change."这句话表明，在内战和1962年之间，关于选民权利的案件审理揭示了一种意识形态和社会变化的模式，这就像一位考古学家剖析不同层次，发现了变化的迹象。因此，这些决定反映了社会思想的演变，对应E选项。

其他选项：
inconsistent with the record of judicial decisions regarding related political issues
文章没有也没有将选民权利的决定与其他政治问题的决定进行对比。
unlikely to be helpful in arguing present-day cases
文章没有讨论这些历史决定在现今案件中的实际应用或相关性。
counter to the principles upheld in the case of Baker v. Carr

a reflection of the lack of federal court jurisdiction over cases bearing on politics

html: Business historians differ from economic historians on the subject of economic markets. When analyzing economic progress, many economic historians see markets as central and individual businesses as only incidental. While entrepreneurs may determine the strategies of their businesses, market competition selects the businesses that pursue the most efficient strategies, thereby determining the patterns of business success and failure. Business historians, by contrast, have traditionally seen firms as much more autonomous and markets as mainly responsive to firms. Until 1980, under the influence of Alfred D. Chandler, Jr., business history focused heavily on the evolution of the modern corporation. The study of markets was, to some extent, reduced to the study of the marketing activities of large firms—their creation of demand through salesmanship and advertising, and their use of first-mover advantage to gain monopoly power. Since 1980, however, there has been significant convergence between economic and business history, although a considerable gap remains. For example, both economic and business historians have examined the history of antitrust, the regulation of utilities, and the evolution of modern financial markets from broadly similar points of view.
zh:
①在经济市场这一主题上，商业史学家与经济史学家有所不同。
②在分析经济进步时，许多经济史学家认为市场是核心，个体企业只是附带的。
③虽然企业家可以决定其企业的战略，但市场竞争会选择追求最有效战略的企业，从而决定企业的成败模式。
④相比之下，商业史学家历来认为企业的自主性要强得多，而市场主要是对企业做出反应。
⑤直到 1980 年，在 ADCJ 的影响下，商业史主要关注现代公司的演变。
⑥对市场的研究在某种程度上被简化为对大公司营销活动的研究--通过销售技巧和广告创造需求，以及利用先发优势获得垄断权。
⑦然而，自 1980 年以来，经济史和商业史之间出现了显著的趋同，但仍存在相当大的差距。
⑧例如，经济史学家和商业史学家都从大致相同的角度研究了反垄断、公用事业监管和现代金融市场演变的历史。

qs.stem: It can be inferred that the economic historians discussed in the passage would probably agree with which of the following regarding the "creation of demand through salesmanship and advertising"?
qs.zh: 关于 “通过销售技巧和广告创造需求”，我们可以推断，文中讨论的经济史学家可能会同意以下哪项观点？

opts.t: It is not as important to business success as many business historians have tended to think.
opts.cn: 它对企业成功的重要性并不像许多商业史学家倾向于认为的那样。

opts.t: It has not been actively pursued by as many businesses as business historians have tended to think.
opts.cn: 并不像许多商业史学家所认为的那样，许多企业都在积极追求这一目标。

opts.t: It has helped some firms gain monopoly power.
opts.cn: 它帮助一些企业获得了垄断地位。

opts.t: It has led to a number of unfair and deceptive business practices.
opts.cn: 它导致了一些不公平和欺骗性的商业行为。

opts.t: It would, if adequately studied, shed light on the evolution of modern financial markets.
opts.cn: 如果对它进行充分研究，将有助于了解现代金融市场的演变。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
文中两派观点：
经济史学家：市场是核心，企业只是附带。真正决定成败的是市场竞争，而不是企业自身的“销售手段”。
商业史学家：企业更自主，市场是对企业的反应。他们更重视大公司通过销售、广告、先发优势等手段来获取成功。

经济史学家认为市场竞争才是决定企业成败的核心，而不是广告/推销；这说明他们会觉得商业史学家过分强调了广告作用。
对应原文：“market competition selects the businesses that pursue the most efficient strategies, thereby determining the patterns of business success and failure.”
所以他们会同意广告没那么重要，选A选项。

其他选项：
It has not been actively pursued by as many businesses as business historians have tended to think.
文中没有说广告是否“被多少企业采用”，经济史学家的重点是市场优先，不是数量问题。

It has helped some firms gain monopoly power.
这其实是商业史学家的观点：“… their use of first-mover advantage to gain monopoly power.”
经济史学家不会强调广告创造垄断，而是强调市场机制。

It has led to a number of unfair and deceptive business practices.
文中完全没提“不公平/欺骗”。

It would, if adequately studied, shed light on the evolution of modern financial markets.
文中确实提到“现代金融市场”研究，但那是两派的共同研究点（反垄断、管制、金融市场），和广告/推销无关。

qs.stem: The author mentions “their use of first-mover advantage to gain monopoly power” most likely to
qs.zh: 作者提到 "他们利用先发优势获得垄断地位"，很可能是为了

opts.t: criticize certain business historians for the narrowness of their focus
opts.cn: 批评某些商业史学家关注点狭窄

opts.t: show how some firms can gain an unfair advantage over others
opts.cn: 说明某些公司如何获得对其他公司不公平的优势

opts.t: provide an example of the limited topics related to markets examined by business historians prior to 1980
opts.cn: 举例说明 1980 年以前商业史学家研究的与市场有关的主题有多有限

opts.t: identify a topic that has become increasingly popular among the newest generation of business historians
opts.cn: 指出一个在新一代商业史学家中日益流行的主题

opts.t: point out an area of convergence between business and economic history
opts.cn: 指出商业史和经济史的一个交汇点

qs.label: C
qs.why:
根据加粗所在句，“The study of markets was, to some extent, reduced to the study of the marketing activities of large firms-the creation of demand through salesmanship and advertising, and their use of first-mover advantage to gain monopoly power.” 这说明在1980年之前，商业历史学家研究市场的方式相对有限，主要关注大公司的营销活动和如何通过首创优势获得市场垄断。对应C选项。（however转折之后，文章最后两句开始描述1980后的情况）

其他选项：
criticize certain business historians for the narrowness of their focus:
文中并没有直接批评商业历史学家，而是描述了研究范围的变化和特点。
show how some firms can gain an unfair advantage over others:
文章中提到的首创优势获得垄断力量并不是为了展示不公平优势，而是例证了过去商业历史学家关注的研究主题。
identify a topic that has become increasingly popular among the newest generation of business historians:
文章提到的是1980年前的研究主题，而不是新一代商业历史学家越来越关注的话题。
point out an area of convergence between business and economic history:
虽然文章最后提到了商业历史和经济历史之间的一些融合，但提及首创优势和垄断力量的部分并不是用来示例这种融合的。

qs.stem: The passage implies that business historians and economic historians would be most likely to disagree regarding which of the following?
qs.zh: 这段话暗示，商业史学家和经济史学家最有可能在以下哪个问题上产生分歧？

opts.t: The extent to which the evolution of the large corporation was conducive to economic growth and progress
opts.cn: 大公司的发展在多大程度上有利于经济增长和进步

opts.t: The extent to which some large firms were able to use first-mover advantage to gain monopoly power
opts.cn: 一些大公司能够在多大程度上利用先行者优势获得垄断地位

opts.t: Whether the history of antitrust is an appropriate field of study for both business and economic historians
opts.cn: 反托拉斯史是否是商业史家和经济史家的适当研究领域

opts.t: Whether overall market conditions are more determinative of business success than is the behavior of individual firms
opts.cn: 整体市场条件是否比单个企业的行为更能决定企业的成败

opts.t: Whether the evolution of the small business affected the evolution of the large corporation
opts.cn: 小企业的发展是否影响了大公司的发展

qs.label: D
qs.why:
文章的核心内容是讨论经济史学家和商业史学家在经济市场的分析角度上的不同。
关键差异在于：
经济史学家认为市场是中心，企业只是附带的，市场竞争决定了哪些企业会成功，哪些会失败。
商业史学家则认为企业更具自主性，市场对企业的反应更多。
根据文章的描述，经济史学家认为市场决定企业的成败，而商业史学家则认为企业行为更为重要。所以二者最可能在 “整体市场条件是否比个体企业行为更决定商业成功” 这一问题上产生分歧，对应D选项。

其他选项：
The extent to which the evolution of the large corporation was conducive to economic growth and progress
尽管经济史学家和商业史学家对公司演变的看法不同，但文章并没有特别描述他们在这一点上的分歧。

The extent to which some large firms were able to use first-mover advantage to gain monopoly power
这是关于商业史学家的视角，强调大公司如何通过先发优势获得垄断权。但这并不是经济史学家和商业史学家之间的主要分歧。

Whether the history of antitrust is an appropriate field of study for both business and economic historians
文章最后提到，尽管经济史和商业史之间存在差距，但在反垄断历史等方面已经出现了趋同。
（"For example, both economic and business historians have examined the history of antitrust, the regulation of utilities, and the evolution of modern financial markets from broadly similar points of view." ）

Whether the evolution of the small business affected the evolution of the large corporation
文章没有提到小企业对大企业演变的影响，也没有暗示过这是经济史学家与商业史学家之间的主要分歧点。

qs.stem: The passage suggests which of the following about the “convergence”?
qs.zh: 关于 "趋同"，文章暗示了以下哪一点？

opts.t: It does not apply to every aspect of business and economic history.
opts.cn: 它并不适用于商业史和经济史的各个方面。

opts.t: It has been pursued more aggressively by business historians than by economic historians.
opts.cn: 商业史学家比经济史学家更积极地追求 "趋同"。

opts.t: It has been exaggerated by both business and economic historians.
opts.cn: 商业史学家和经济史学家都夸大了 "趋同"。

opts.t: It has brought about new understanding of the evolution of the corporation.
opts.cn: 它使人们对公司的演变有了新的认识。

opts.t: It applies most directly to areas of specialization that have emerged since the 1980s.
opts.cn: 它最直接地适用于 20 世纪 80 年代以来出现的专业领域。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
文章在最后一段中提到，尽管经济史和商业史在研究观点上的趋同有所提高，但仍存在较大的差距。这表明这种趋同并未适用于经济与商业历史的所有方面，对应A选项。

其他选项：
It has been pursued more aggressively by business historians than by economic historians.
原文没有提到商业史学家比经济史学家更积极地推动这种趋同。

It has been exaggerated by both business and economic historians.
原文没有提到趋同的程度被夸大。

It has brought about new understanding of the evolution of the corporation.
原文没有提到趋同带来了对现代公司发展的新理解。提到公司发展的部分只和1980年前的商业史有关，不是趋同的结果。

It applies most directly to areas of specialization that have emerged since the 1980s.
原文确实提到自1980年以来，两个领域对某些具体问题（如反垄断法、公共事业监管等）有了共同的关注，但没有说这些领域是自1980年后才新兴的。

html: Study of the geological history of the Moon is based on the law of superposition, which states that younger rocks and geological features visibly overlie older rocks and features. For example, lines—or “rays”—radiate outward from the crater Copernicus and overlie the rim of the neighboring crater Eratosthenes, demonstrating that Copernicus is younger. Both of these craters are younger than the dark lava plain, Mare Imbrium, upon which they lie. In contrast, the crater Archimedes is filled with and surrounded by this dark lava, from which its rim protrudes; thus, the impact that created Archimedes predates the lava eruption that flooded the whole region to create Mare Imbrium. All the foregoing features occur inside the giant Imbrium basin, itself a kind of colossal impact crater. Thus, the relative ages of surface features in the Imbrium-Copernicus region were unambiguously derivable from photographs taken from Earth well before any lunar missions. Their absolute ages, however, were only later inferred from physical samples of lunar rock.
zh:
①对月球地质历史的研究是基于叠加定律，即较年轻的岩石和地质特征明显地叠加在较古老的岩石和地质特征之上。
②例如，从C环形山向外放射的线条或 "射线"，覆盖了邻近的E环形山的边缘，这表明C环形山更年轻。
③这两个陨石坑都比它们所在的暗熔岩平原MI年轻。
④与此相反，A环形山被深色熔岩填满并包围着，环形山的边缘从熔岩中凸出；因此，产生A环形山的撞击早于熔岩喷发淹没整个地区形成MI的时间。
⑤所有上述地貌都出现在巨大的I盆地内，而I盆地本身就是一个巨大的撞击坑。
⑥因此，IC地区地表特征的相对年龄，早在任何月球任务之前就可以通过从地球拍摄的照片明确推算出来。
⑦然而，它们的绝对年龄是后来才从月球岩石的物理样本中推断出来的。

qs.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that which of the following geological events occurred first?
qs.zh: 从文中可以推断出，以下哪项地质事件最先发生？

opts.t: The impact that formed the rays of Copernicus
opts.cn: 形成C射线的撞击

opts.t: The impact that formed Eratosthenes
opts.cn: 形成E的撞击

opts.t: The eruption that flooded Archimedes
opts.cn: 淹没A的火山爆发

opts.t: The formation of the Imbrium basin
opts.cn: I盆地的形成

opts.t: The creation of Mare Imbrium
opts.cn: MI的形成

qs.label: D
qs.why: 文中提到 "All the foregoing features occur inside the giant Imbrium basin" (所有上述特征都发生在Imbrium盆地内)，表明 I盆地形成在这些特征之前。因此，I盆地的形成应该是最早的事件，选D选项。

html:
This passage is adapted from material published in 1992.

The recently announced discovery of the first known planet orbiting a pulsar (the ultradense, pulsating remnant off the supernova explosion of a star) turned out to be based on faulty data. Had this discovery been confirmed, theorists would have had difficulty accounting for the existence of such a planet. The supernova would certainly have destroyed any preexisting planets. This particular pulsar is relatively young, allowing little time for a new planet to have coalesced, and it rotates relatively slowly, implying that it has not interacted with any nearby star since the supernova.
But newer evidence of a different pulsar with planets is more promising. This is a rapidly spurring “millisecond pulsar” thought to be a much older object that has pulled gaseous material from a stellar neighbor, causing its rotational speed to increase. Leftover, unconsumed gas around such a pulsar could, in theory, coalesce into planets. Or the pulsar’s radiation might have vaporized a companion star, providing new material for planetary formation.
zh:
这段话改编自 1992 年出版的资料。

①最近宣布发现的第一颗已知的绕脉冲星（恒星超新星爆炸后的超密度脉动残余物）运行的行星结果是基于错误的数据。
②如果这一发现得到证实，理论家就很难解释这样一颗行星的存在。
③超新星肯定会摧毁任何先前存在的行星。
④这颗特殊的脉冲星相对年轻，几乎没有时间让一颗新行星聚合，而且它的旋转速度也相对缓慢，这意味着自超新星诞生以来，它没有与附近的任何恒星发生过相互作用。

⑤但新的证据表明，另一个带有行星的脉冲星更有希望是事实。
⑥这是一个快速喷射的“毫秒脉冲星”，被认为是一个更古老的物体，它从一个临近的恒星拉气体物质，从而增加自身旋转速度。
⑦从理论上讲，这样一颗脉冲星周围剩余的未消耗气体可以合并成行星。
⑧或者脉冲星的辐射可能蒸发了伴星，为行星的形成提供了新的物质。

qs.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to
qs.zh: 这篇文章的主要目的是

opts.t: provide an example of the dangers of prematurely announcing a discovery based on unconfirmed evidence
opts.cn: 提供一个基于未经证实的证据过早宣布发现的危险示例

opts.t: illustrate the difficulty of constructing plausible theoretical explanations of observational data
opts.cn: 展示构造观测数据合理理论解释的困难

opts.t: assess the credibility of recent findings concerning the as yet unverified existence of a class of objects.
opts.cn: 评估关于尚未证实存在一类物体的最近的研究结果的可信度

opts.t: argue that a certain hypothesis fails to account for seemingly contradictory conclusions in two similar cases
opts.cn: 认为某一假设无法解释两个相似案例中看似矛盾的结论

opts.t: demonstrate how new evidence can prompt theorists to question the reality of a phenomenon previously thought to be confirmed
opts.cn: 展示新的证据如何促使理论家质疑先前被认为已被证实的现象的真实性

qs.label: C
qs.why:
文章第一段首句说最近宣布发现的第一颗绕脉冲星运行的行星其实是基于错误的数据。后三句解释为什么这一发现是不可信的。
第二段开始讲另一个带有行星的脉冲星。后三句解释新发现为什么是可信的(more promising)。
全文评估关于绕脉冲星运行的行星的两个的研究结果的可信度, 对应C选项。

其他选项：
provide an example of the dangers of prematurely announcing a discovery based on unconfirmed evidence
文章提到了错误的数据，但主要目的是讨论新发现的可信度，而不是强调过早宣布的危险。

illustrate the difficulty of constructing plausible theoretical explanations of observational data
虽然提到了理论学家可能难以解释，但文章主要不是在说明这种困难。

argue that a certain hypothesis fails to account for seemingly contradictory conclusions in two similar cases
文章没有讨论某一假设未能解释矛盾的结论。

demonstrate how new evidence can prompt theorists to question the reality of a phenomenon previously thought to be confirmed
文章并没说明新的证据让理论学家质疑已被证实的现象；新证据使行星存在更有可能。

qs.stem: Which of the following can be inferred regarding the pulsar discussed in the first paragraph?
qs.zh: 关于第一段中讨论的脉冲星，可以推断出以下哪项？

opts.t: Theorists initially doubted its existence
opts.cn: 理论家最初怀疑它的存在

opts.t: If its existence had been confirmed, astronomers would and have turned their attention to the pulsar discussed in the second paragraph.
opts.cn: 如果它的存在已经被证实，天文学家们将会并且已经把他们的注意力转移到第二段讨论的脉冲星上

opts.t: If the supernovas explosions that created it had been more powerful, the resulting radiation would have preceded the subsequent formation of a planet.
opts.cn: 如果创造它的超新星爆炸更强大，产生的辐射将会在行星形成之前出现

opts.t: If it had interacted with a nearby star since the supernova explosion, it would rotate faster than it does.
opts.cn: 如果它在超新星爆炸后与附近的恒星相互作用，它的旋转速度会比它快

opts.t: Astronomers’ interest in it ultimately led to a new theory of planetary formation.
opts.cn: 天文学家对它的兴趣最终导致了一种新的行星形成理论

qs.label: D
qs.why:
D选项对应第一段最后一句" it rotates relatively slowly, implying that it has not interacted with any nearby star since the supernova"。它的旋转速度也相对缓慢，这意味它没有与附近的任何恒星发生过相互作用。推出如果事实相反, 它在超新星爆炸后与附近的恒星相互作用, 那么它的旋转速度会比现在更快。

其他选项：
Theorists initially doubted its existence.
文中没有提到理论学家对该脉冲星本身的存在有怀疑，而是提到对行星的存在感到困惑。
If its existence had been confirmed, astronomers would have turned their attention to the pulsar discussed in the second paragraph.
第一段并未提到两者之间有直接的因果关系，文中只是讨论了两个脉冲星的行星形成机制，没有说一个被证实会转移注意力到另一个。
If the supernova explosion that created it had been more powerful, the resulting radiation would have preceded the subsequent formation of a planet.
原文提到的是超新星摧毁了现有的行星，但没有提到辐射的强度对行星形成的具体影响。
Astronomers’ interest in it ultimately led to a new theory of planetary formation.
第一段没有提到这个脉冲星对行星形成理论的具体贡献，而是提到另一颗脉冲星（第二段讨论的）提供了更有希望的证据。

html:
The passage as adapted from material published in 2005.

Given that ants and aphids are both abundant insect groups that often share the same habitats, that aphids excrete energy-rich honeydew, and that ants aggressively defend resources, it is difficult to understand why so few species of aphid have evolved a close relationship with ants. For example, only a quarter of the aphid species in the Rocky Mountain region are attended by ants, and in Central Europe, about one third are obligate myrmecophiles [animals that closely associate with ants]. More than a dozen hypotheses have been proposed to account for the variability in aphid-ant relationships and the low proportion of attended species. First among them is the plant permissive hypothesis, which suggests that host-plant quality plays a critical role in determining the attractiveness of aphids for ants. Both variation in the quality of different hosts or different parts of the same host plant may affect the quality of honeydew, which is either more or less attractive to ants. However, this hypothesis ignores the fact that several species of aphids may feed on the same host plant or even plant organ but have very different degrees of associations with ants and assumes that the quality of phloem sap determines that of honeydew. Recent studies have found that feeding on woody plant parts is positively associated with ant attendance, whereas mobility, feeding in isolation, and having winged adults are negatively associated with ant attendance.
zh:
这段话改编自 2005 年发表的材料。

①鉴于蚂蚁和蚜虫都是数量庞大的昆虫群体，经常共享相同的栖息地，蚜虫会排泄能量丰富的蜜露，而蚂蚁会积极保护资源，因此很难理解为什么很少有蚜虫物种与蚂蚁进化出密切的关系。
②例如，在落基山地区，只有四分之一的蚜虫种类与蚂蚁为伍，而在中欧地区，大约三分之一的蚜虫是嗜蚁动物（与蚂蚁密切相关的动物）。
③为了解释蚜虫与蚂蚁关系的多变性和有蚂蚁参与的物种比例较低的原因，人们提出了十多种假说。
④其中首先是植物许可假说，它认为寄主植物的质量在决定蚜虫对蚂蚁的吸引力方面起着关键作用。
⑤不同寄主植物或同一寄主植物不同部位的质量差异都可能影响蜜露的质量，而蜜露对蚂蚁的吸引力有大有小。
⑥然而，这种假设忽略了一个事实，即多种蚜虫可能以同一种寄主植物甚至植物器官为食，但与蚂蚁的关联程度却大不相同，并假定韧皮部汁液的质量决定了蜜露的质量。
⑦最近的研究发现，取食木本植物部分与蚂蚁的出勤率呈正相关，而流动性、孤立取食和有翅成虫与蚂蚁的出勤率呈负相关。

qs.stem: Which of the following, if true, would best support the plant permissive hypothesis?
qs.zh: 如果以下哪项为真，最能支持植物许可假说？

opts.t: Aphids that feed on different species of plants produce honeydew of varying quality
opts.cn: 以不同种类植物为食的蚜虫会产生不同质量的蜜露

opts.t: Seasonal changes in the quality of phloem sap are a common phenomenon in plants.
opts.cn: 植物韧皮部汁液质量的季节性变化是一种常见现象。

opts.t: Many aphid species with extremely nutritious honeydew are not attended by ants.
opts.cn: 许多蜜露营养价值极高的蚜虫种类都没有蚂蚁的踪迹。

opts.t: Some species of aphids inhabit more than one species of plant.
opts.cn: 有些种类的蚜虫栖息在不止一种植物上。

opts.t: The Rocky Mountain region and Central Europe have few plant species in common.
opts.cn: 落基山地区和中欧的共同植物种类很少。

qs.label: A
qs.why:
假说内容：宿主植物的质量决定蚜虫对蚂蚁的吸引力。具体来说，宿主植物的差异可能影响蚜虫分泌的蜜露质量，而蜜露的质量会影响蚂蚁是否“关注”这些蚜虫。

A选项说，蚜虫在不同植物上进食会产生不同质量的蜜露，直接支持了植物种类影响蜜露质量。

其他选项：
Seasonal changes in the quality of phloem sap are a common phenomenon in plants
这个选项虽然提到植物质量变化，但没有说明这种变化如何影响蚜虫和蚂蚁的关系。
Many aphid species with extremely nutritious honeydew are not attended by ants
如果植物质量高却未吸引蚂蚁，说明其他因素在起更重要的作用。
Some species of aphids inhabit more than one species of plant
没有提到蜜露质量变化如何影响蚂蚁的行为。
The Rocky Mountain region and Central Europe have few plant species in common
这个选项和研究区域有关，但没有具体讨论植物质量和蜜露质量的关系。

html:
The idea of religious music as being the artistically purest form of Black musical expression has deep roots: W.E.B.Du Bois, James Weldon Johnson, and Alain Locke are just a few prominent intellectuals who held the spirituals to be the pinnacles of Black art in the United States during the first part of the twentieth century, with Du Bois describing them as “ the most beautiful expression of human experience, born this side of the seas....the singular spiritual heritage of the nation and the greatest gift of the Negro people. ”

The elevation of religious music to the epitome of authentic Black musicality speaks to a broader tendency noted by Karl Hagstrom Miller: the urge for critics and historians to describe Black music making in terms that are inherently collecti v e. This has extended to nonmusical contexts, in which the called-and-response dynamic, the “ ring shout ,” and jazz-derived metaphors or collective interaction have been highly influential in discussions of African American culture generally. While certainly useful, Miller points out that the abundance of metaphors about music making as a collective experience has a tendency to trap individuals within a racial collectivity, naturalizing music as an outgrowth of one's life rather than a cultivated talent and obscuring the meaning and uses of art that falls outside of racially defined cultural borders. ” In other words, individuating traits such as technique, ambition, and stylistic diversity become subordinated to one's role within a group and his or her imagined obligations to that group.
zh:
①宗教音乐是黑人音乐最纯粹的艺术表现形式，这种观点有着深厚的渊源： WDB、JWJ 和 AL 等著名知识分子都认为灵歌是 20 世纪上半叶美国黑人艺术的巅峰之作，DB 称灵歌为 "人类经验最美丽的表达，诞生于大海之滨....，是国家独一无二的精神遗产，也是黑人最伟大的礼物。"

②KHM 指出，将宗教音乐提升为真正黑人音乐性的缩影说明了一种更广泛的趋势：评论家和历史学家倾向于用固有的集体术语来描述黑人音乐创作。
③这种趋势已经延伸到非音乐领域，其中 "呼唤与回应"（called-and-response dynamic）、"环形呼喊"（the ring shout）以及源自爵士乐的隐喻或集体互动在有关非裔美国人文化的讨论中具有很大的影响力。
④M指出，大量关于音乐创作是一种集体体验的隐喻固然有用，但往往会将个人困在种族集体中，将音乐自然化为个人生活的产物而非培养出来的天赋，并掩盖了种族文化边界之外的艺术的意义和用途。"
⑤换句话说，诸如技巧、抱负和风格多样性等个性化特质都从属于一个人在群体中的角色以及他或她对该群体的想象义务。

qs.stem: In the context in which it appears, “ imagined ” most nearly means
qs.zh: 根据上下文，"imagined"最接近的意思是

opts.t: fabricated
opts.cn: 编造的

opts.t: ideal
opts.cn: 理想的

opts.t: creative
opts.cn: 创造性的

opts.t: presumed
opts.cn: 假定的

opts.t: intangible
opts.cn: 无形的

qs.label: D
qs.why: 在上下文中，"imagined" 一词用于描述个体在种族集体中的角色和义务，这些角色和义务未必是现实的，而是被假设或设想出来的。因此，这里的“imagined”最接近的意思是“presumed”，即假定的或预设的。

qs.stem: The author of the passage quotes Du Bois most likely to
qs.zh: 作者引用DB的话很可能是为了

opts.t: clarify an aesthetic principle that has been difficult to comprehend
opts.cn: 澄清一个难以理解的美学原则

opts.t: establish the actual source of a frequently misattributed argument
opts.cn: 确定一个经常被错误引用的论点的真正来源

opts.t: evoke a sense of the cultural authority associated with a particular view
opts.cn: 唤起一种与特定观点相关的文化权威感

opts.t: compare Du Bois's definition of a term to Miller's definition of that term
opts.h: compare Du Bois's definition of a term to Miller's definition of that term
opts.cn: 将DB对某个术语的定义与M对该术语的定义进行比较

opts.t: distinguish Du Bois's position from those of Johnson and Locke
opts.h: distinguish Du Bois's position from those of Johnson and Locke
opts.cn: 将DB的立场与J和L的立场区分开来

qs.label: C
qs.why:
DB 被提及来强化特定观点（即黑人精神歌曲作为美国黑人艺术的顶峰）的权威性。DB 将精神歌曲描述为“人类经验最美丽的表达……这一边海域的独特的精神遗产和黑人民族的最大礼物。”这段话表明他对这种音乐形式的高度评价，引用他的观点能够增加这种观点的文化权威性，对应C选项。

其他选项：
clarify an aesthetic principle that has been difficult to comprehend
文章中并没有指出DB的引用是用来阐明某个难以理解的审美原则。他的话更多是赞美和评价。
establish the actual source of a frequently misattributed argument
文章中没有提到这一观点经常被误归咎于其他人。
compare Du Bois's definition of a term to Miller's definition of that term
文章并没有提到DB和M对某个术语的定义进行比较。
distinguish Du Bois's position from those of Johnson and Locke
虽然文中提到了其他知识分子（如Johnson和Locke），但DB的引用并不是用来区分他们之间的立场，而是用来代表一种共同的看法。

qs.stem: Which of the following statements best characterizes the relationship between the two paragraphs?
qs.zh: 以下哪项陈述最能说明这两段之间的关系？

opts.t: The first paragraph explains why a certain genre was held in high regard by critics: the: second paragraph suggests that a reevaluation of the genre is necessary.
opts.cn: 第一段解释了某一体裁受到评论家高度评价的原因：第二段提出有必要重新评价这一体裁。

opts.t: The first paragraph introduces a certain definition of authenticity: the second paragraph explores whether this definition is broad enough to accommodate new developments in a field.
opts.h: The first paragraph introduces a certain definition of authenticity: the second paragraph explores whether this definition is broad enough to accommodate new developments in a field.
opts.cn: 第一段介绍了真实性的某种定义：第二段探讨了这一定义是否足够宽泛，以适应某一领域的新发展。

opts.t: The first paragraph acknowledges the contributions of a group of intellectuals to a debate: the second paragraph identifies a later critic who denounced the conclusions of the earlier group.
opts.cn: 第一段肯定了一批知识分子在辩论中的贡献：第二段指出了后来的一位批评家，他谴责了前一批知识分子的结论。

opts.t: The first paragraph explains the importance of a genre of music to a particular community; the second paragraph shows how that community's values are reflected in the music's style.
opts.h: The first paragraph explains the importance of a genre of music to a particular community; the second paragraph shows how that community's values are reflected in the music's style.
opts.cn: 第一段解释某一音乐流派对某一群体的重要性；第二段说明该群体的价值观如何在音乐风格中得到体现。

opts.t: The first paragraph traces the origins of an influential idea in a particular field; the second paragraph points out possible drawbacks that resulted from embracing that idea.
opts.cn: 第一段追溯某一领域有影响力的观点的起源；第二段指出接受该观点可能带来的弊端。

qs.label: E
qs.why:
第一段：追溯了“宗教音乐是最纯粹黑人音乐表达”的观念的来源（Du Bois 等人）。
第二段：指出了这种观念可能带来的消极影响（集体化叙事会忽视个人特质）。
选E选项。

其他选项：
The first paragraph explains why a certain genre was held in high regard by critics; the second paragraph suggests that a reevaluation of the genre is necessary.
第一段确实解释了宗教音乐被推崇的背景，但第二段并不是直接说“要重新评价这个流派”，而是批评了背后的 集体化框架，而不是要求对音乐本身做直接的重新评价。

The first paragraph introduces a certain definition of authenticity; the second paragraph explores whether this definition is broad enough to accommodate new developments in a field.
第一段并没有直接定义“authenticity”，只是给出了宗教音乐被视为纯粹的背景。第二段也没有提到“新发展”（new developments），它批评的是集体化叙事的弊端。

The first paragraph acknowledges the contributions of a group of intellectuals to a debate; the second paragraph identifies a later critic who denounced the conclusions of the earlier group.
Miller 的观点不是单纯“否定结论”，而是指出这种思想模式的弊端。他并不是直接和 Du Bois 他们在一个辩论中针锋相对，而是在更宏观的文化批评中指出问题。

The first paragraph explains the importance of a genre of music to a particular community; the second paragraph shows how that community's values are reflected in the music's style.
第二段并没有分析音乐的风格如何体现社区价值，而是批评集体化观念可能压制个人特色。

html: Larvae of many marine invertebrate species delay their metamorphosis into juveniles when cues signaling an appropriate juvenile environment are absent, thereby increasing their likelihood of thriving as juveniles and of ultimately reaching adulthood. Nevertheless, delayed metamorphosis has potential costs for juveniles, including reduced growth and increased mortality. Nearly all evidence of such costs involves species whose larvae do not feed but rather subsist on stored nutrients, indicating that insufficient energy reserves may be an underlying cause of these costs. Supporting this hypothesis are laboratory studies showing that in a certain bryozoan, the prolonged larval swimming that results from delayed metamorphosis is associated with size reductions in the juvenile feeding organ (the lophophore) and that one factor influencing the size of juveniles of certain barnacle species is how long larvae delay metamorphosis. However, other studies show that while significantly fewer juvenile Capitella worms survived to adulthood when metamorphosis had been delayed, prolonged larval swimming had no significant effect on juvenile size, suggesting, perhaps, that in some species, factors other than insufficient energy reserves account for the negative effects of the larval stresses that result from delayed metamorphosis.
zh:
①许多海洋无脊椎动物的幼体在没有适当的幼体环境信号的情况下，会推迟其变态为幼年，从而增加其作为幼体繁衍生息并最终达到成年的可能性。
②然而，延迟变态对幼年有潜在的代价，包括生长减少和死亡率增加。
③几乎所有这类代价的证据都涉及到那些幼体不进食而是依靠储存的营养物生存的物种，这表明能量储备不足可能是造成这些代价的根本原因。
④支持这一假设的实验室研究表明，在某些苔藓动物中，延迟变态导致的幼体长时间游泳与幼年摄食器官（lophophore）的大小减少有关，并且幼体延迟变态的时间是影响某些藤壶物种幼年大小的一个因素。
⑤然而，其他研究表明，虽然幼年小头虫在变态延迟后存活到成年期的数量显著减少，但延长幼体游泳时间对幼年大小没有显著影响，这可能表明，在某些物种中，除了能量储备不足外，其他因素也影响了延迟变态导致的幼体应激的负面影响。

qs.stem: The “hypothesis” implies that compared to marine invertebrate larvae that subsist on stored nutrients, marine invertebrate larvae that feed are less likely to
qs.zh: “假设”认为，与依靠存储营养物质为生的海洋无脊椎动物幼体相比，摄食的海洋无脊椎动物幼体不太可能发生

opts.t: exhibit prolonged larval swimming as a result of delayed metamorphosis
opts.cn: 由于变态发育延迟而表现出延长幼体游泳期

opts.t: experience negative effects as a result of delayed metamorphosis
opts.cn: 由于变态发育延迟而经受负面影响

opts.t: thrive as juveniles in environments inappropriate for juveniles
opts.cn: 作为幼年个体在不适宜幼年生存的环境中茁壮成长

opts.t: delay metamorphosis in the absence of appropriate environmental cues
opts.cn: 在缺乏适宜的环境线索的情况下延迟变态发育

opts.t: delay metamorphosis for an extended period of time
opts.cn: 延迟变态发育一段时间

qs.label: B
qs.why:
“假说（hypothesis）”指的是：“Nearly all evidence of such costs involves species whose larvae do not feed but rather subsist on stored nutrients, indicating that insufficient energy reserves may be an underlying cause of these costs.”
“potential costs for juveniles, including reduced growth and increased mortality.”
也就是说，推迟变态（delayed metamorphosis）的负面影响（reduced growth and increased mortality）很大程度上是因为那些不进食、仅靠储存养分度日的幼虫“能量不足”所致。相比之下，能够在幼虫期进食的物种并不会面临同样的“能量储备不足”问题，所以更不可能遭受因推迟变态而带来的负面影响。选B选项。

其他选项：
exhibit prolonged larval swimming as a result of delayed metamorphosis
文中并没有提出“会否延长游泳时间”与是否进食有关；所有幼虫在缺乏适宜环境信号时都会延迟变态并持续游泳。

thrive as juveniles in environments inappropriate for juveniles
文中说推迟变态有助于在适合的环境中存活，但这里讨论的是负面成本，和“在不适环境中更好生存”无关。

delay metamorphosis in the absence of appropriate environmental cues
无论是否进食，只要缺少环境信号，幼虫都会推迟变态；进食能力不影响“是否延迟变态”。

delay metamorphosis for an extended period of time
“延迟多长时间”只取决于环境信号，不受能量储备影响。

html: Garlic mustard—a plant native to western Eurasia—has been successful as an invasive species in the United States. Garlic mustard contains a variety of plant secondary compounds that lower its palatability to herbivores. In addition, recent studies suggest that these secondary compounds affect the seed germination and growth of native plants and alter the activity of soil organisms, raising the possibility that secondary compounds in garlic mustard contribute to its overall success as an invader. Although it remains unclear exactly how these secondary compounds penetrate into the soil, their presence appears to affect surrounding plants. Prati and Bossdorf found that the germination rate of a native woodland herb, rough avens, was significantly reduced when grown in soils that had been previously occupied by garlic mustard. To test for the specific effects of root exudates (substances slowly released by roots), they mixed experimental soil samples with activated carbon, a material that binds organic compounds in soil and thereby decreases their activity. They found that more seeds germinated in soils with activated carbon than in soils without activated carbon, suggesting that organic compounds released in the exudates of garlic mustard had a negative effect on the seed germination of native species.
zh:
①大蒜芥--一种原产于欧亚大陆西部的植物--已成功地成为美国的入侵物种。
②大蒜芥含有多种植物次生化合物，会降低其对食草动物的适口性。
③此外，最近的研究表明，这些次生化合物会影响本地植物的种子发芽和生长，并改变土壤中生物的活动，这就提出了一种可能性，即大蒜芥中的次生化合物有助于其作为入侵者取得全面成功。
④虽然目前还不清楚这些次生化合物是如何渗入土壤的，但它们的存在似乎会影响周围的植物。
⑤P 和 B 发现，在曾被大蒜芥占据过的土壤中生长的本地林地草本植物--粗金针菜的发芽率明显降低。
⑥为了测试根部渗出物（根部缓慢释放的物质）的具体影响，他们将实验土壤样本与活性炭混合，活性炭是一种能结合土壤中的有机化合物从而降低其活性的材料。
⑦他们发现，与不含活性碳的土壤相比，在含活性碳的土壤中发芽的种子更多，这表明大蒜芥的渗出物中释放的有机化合物对本地物种的种子发芽有负面影响。

qs.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that Prati and Bossdorf ’ s experiments with activated carbon were intended to determine which of the following?
qs.zh: 从文中可以推断出，P 和 B 用活性炭进行实验的目的是为了确定以下哪项？

opts.t: How the presence of garlic mustard affects the growth rates of other non-native plant species
opts.cn: 大蒜芥的存在如何影响其他非本地植物物种的生长速度

opts.t: Why the presence of activated carbon decreases the activity of organic compounds
opts.cn: 为什么活性炭的存在会降低有机化合物的活性

opts.t: Whether the root exudates of garlic mustard negatively affect the germination rates of native plants
opts.cn: 大蒜芥的根部渗出物是否会对本地植物的发芽率产生负面影响

opts.t: Whether the germination of garlic mustard is affected by the activity of soil organisms
opts.cn: 大蒜芥的发芽是否受土壤生物活动的影响

opts.t: Which secondary compounds found in garlic mustard most lower its palatability to herbivores
opts.cn: 大蒜芥中的哪些次生化合物最能降低其对食草动物的适口性

qs.label: C
qs.why:
Prati 和 Bossdorf 的实验重点是测试大蒜芥根部渗出物对本地植物种子发芽率的影响。

实验目的： “To test for the specific effects of root exudates...”
实验方法： “...they mixed experimental soil samples with activated carbon, a material that binds organic compounds in soil and thereby decreases their activity.”
实验结果： “...more seeds germinated in soils with activated carbon than in soils without activated carbon, suggesting that organic compounds released in the exudates of garlic mustard had a negative effect on the seed germination of native species.”

根据这些信息可得，实验目的是验证大蒜芥根部渗出物中的有机化合物是否对本地植物的发芽有负面影响，对应C选项。

其他选项：
How the presence of garlic mustard affects the growth rates of other non-native plant species
原文提到的是大蒜芥对本地植物（native plants）的影响，不是其他外来物种（non-native plant species）。

Why the presence of activated carbon decreases the activity of organic compounds
实验中的活性炭只是工具，用来验证大蒜芥根部渗出物的效果，不是研究活性炭为何会降低有机化合物的活性。

Whether the germination of garlic mustard is affected by the activity of soil organisms
实验讨论的是本地植物的发芽率，没有研究大蒜芥本身的发芽或其与土壤生物的相互作用。

Which secondary compounds found in garlic mustard most lower its palatability to herbivores
实验与次生化合物降低适口性（palatability）无关，重点是次生化合物对种子发芽的影响。

qs.stem: According to the passage, which of the following occurred during Prat and Bossdorf's experiments?
qs.zh: 根据文章，在 P 和 B 的实验中出现了以下哪种情况？

opts.t: Rough avens plants that had already germinated grew more quickly in soils that contained activated carbon than they did in soils that did not contain it.
opts.cn: 在含有活性碳的土壤中，已经发芽的粗金针菜比在不含活性碳的土壤中生长得更快。

opts.t: More rough avens seeds sprouted in soil with decreased organic compound activity than did seeds in soil with higher levels of organic compound activity.
opts.cn: 与有机化合物活性较高的土壤相比，在有机化合物活性较低的土壤中萌发的毛冠菊种子更多。

opts.t: The growth rate of rough avens plants that had already germinated decreased significantly when the plants were grown in soil that had been previously occupied by garlic mustard.
opts.cn: 已经发芽的粗金针菜，在大蒜芥的土壤里长得更慢

opts.t: The presence of activated carbon negatively affected both the seed germination rates and the plant growth rates of garlic mustard.
opts.cn: 活性炭的存在对大蒜芥的种子发芽率和植株生长率都有负面影响。

opts.t: The activities of soil organisms necessary for the flourishing of rough avens were enhanced by the presence of garlic mustard.
opts.h: The activities of soil organisms necessary for the flourishing of rough avens were enhanced by the presence of garlic mustard.
opts.cn: 大蒜芥的存在增强了土壤生物的活性，而土壤生物的活性对粗金针菜的生长十分必要。

qs.label: B
qs.why:
原文提到，当粗金针菜种子在之前被大蒜芥占据的土壤中生长时，其发芽率显著下降。为了测试根分泌物的具体作用，他们将实验土壤样本与活性炭混合，活性炭会结合土壤中的有机化合物并降低其活性。他们发现，含有活性炭的土壤中比没有活性炭的土壤中发芽的种子更多。
根据这些内容可以推断，在有活性炭的土壤中，由于有机化合物活性降低，粗金针菜种子的发芽率更高。

其他选项：
Rough avens plants that had already germinated grew more quickly in soils that contained activated carbon than they did in soils that did not contain it.
原文只提到 发芽率（germination），完全没提到“已经发芽的植物的生长速度”。

The growth rate of rough avens plants that had already germinated decreased significantly when the plants were grown in soil that had been previously occupied by garlic mustard.
原文没提到“生长速度”，只提到“发芽率减少”。

The presence of activated carbon negatively affected both the seed germination rates and the plant growth rates of garlic mustard.
实验研究的对象是 粗金针菜（native species），不是大蒜芥（入侵种）。文章里根本没提“活性炭对大蒜芥的影响”。

The activities of soil organisms necessary for the flourishing of rough avens were enhanced by the presence of garlic mustard.
文章说的是大蒜芥分泌物 破坏了土壤生物的活动，并且对本地植物有抑制作用，而不是增强。

qs.stem: According to the passage, which of the following statements about the plant secondary compounds found in garlic mustard is true?
qs.zh: 根据文章，关于大蒜芥中发现的植物次生化合物，以下哪种说法是正确的？

opts.t: They make garlic mustard less appetizing to plant-eating animals.
opts.cn: 它们会降低大蒜芥对吃植物的动物的吸引力。

opts.t: They alter the activity of soil-dwelling organisms.
opts.cn: 它们会改变土壤中生物的活动。

opts.t: They appear to decrease the germination rates of native plant species.
opts.cn: 它们似乎会降低本地植物物种的发芽率。

qs.label: A B C
qs.why:
“Garlic mustard contains a variety of plant secondary compounds that lower its palatability to herbivores.”明确指出大蒜芥的次生化合物降低了对食草动物的适口性，A选项正确。

“…these secondary compounds affect the seed germination and growth of native plants and alter the activity of soil organisms…”提到这些次生化合物会影响土壤生物的活动，B选项正确。

“Prati and Bossdorf found that the germination rate of a native woodland herb, rough avens, was significantly reduced when grown in soils that had been previously occupied by garlic mustard.”实验发现，大蒜芥对土壤的影响降低了本地植物种子的发芽率，C选项正确。
